tim gilliam.name: Tim Gilliam
tim gilliam.first_appearance: Marvel Disk Wars: The Avengers Season 1 1
tim gilliam.origin: Tim Gilliam is the leader of the Celebrity Five, five human criminals that work directly for Loki Laufeyson. In his daily life he was an employee of S.H.I.E.L.D. before revealing his true colors. Tim Gilliam was one of the Celebrity Five members that helped Loki during his attack on the Raft. He helped release the various supervillains from their cells so they could attack the Avengers. He also smuggled some villains on board the Helicarrier to keep S.H.I.E.L.D. busy. When Akira and Hikaru tried to reach the heliport with the last Biocode Installer, Tim and M.O.D.O.K. intercepted them. Tim ordered M.O.D.O.K. to destroy the installer, but could not prevent the installer from giving the two boys and their 3 friends a biocode. He and Loki had to retreat when Akira used his new biocode to D-smash Iron Man, and accidently caused the other DISKs to get scattered across the globe. From then on, Tim became a recurring opponent for the Avengers and their young partners. He also began his attempts to replace magic with technology, starting by building a teleportation device for instant travel between Loki's ice palace and every other location. As the scientist of the team, he was also responsible for assiting Dr. Akatsuki in building the Power Transfer device which Loki intended to use to transfer the powers of all heroes and villians in the DISKs to himself. Tim managed to work out all the bugs Dr. Akatsuki put in the machine to stall time, and even mocked Akatsuki for thinking he wouldn't notice. When Loki was initially defeated in the battle at his Ice Palace, and banished to the Dark Dimension, the Celebrity Five were arrested. Tim didn't mind, and thought that they could easily strike a bargain with S.H.I.E.L.D. since they still had their biocodes. The team was broken out of prison transport by Crossbones, who proceeded to steal their Biocodes and then forcefully drafted them in to Hydra. Like his fellow Celebrity Five members, Tim hated being a Hydra soldier, considering it a disgrace that a scientist like him was forced to do manual labour. Tim was ordered to help Abomination guard one of the 5 Gaia Anchors with which Red Skull intended to destroy the world. When Edward Grant and Hulk come to the Raft to destroy the Anchor, the Celebrity Five actually helped them accomplish this goal since they wanted to see Red Skull fail. When Red Skull was likewise defeated and Hydra dissolved, Tim and the other Celebrity Five became fugitives. With their reputations destroyed, they visited their old lair to salvage whatever valuables they could find. It was here that Loki contacted the group again from the other dimension he had been banished to. He restored their biocodes and ordered them to prepare forh is return, starting with an attack on a security conference. Presumably to steal the passwords for all security systems of the countries represented at the conference. Tim was the only one of the Celebrity Five to which Loki told the true reason for this attack; lure the Avengers out, and use a special energy storing device to absorb an attack from Iron Mans' Build Up Armor. When Loki's new henchman Ronin arrived from the Dark Dimension, he usurped Tim as leader of the Celebrity Five and led them in a mission to steal the Treasures of Darkenss for Loki, which he needed to powerup a machine called the Dark Gate device and open an even greater portal to the Dark Dimension in order to release Dormammu. Tim accompanied Ronin to Loki's old Ice Palace to retrieve a computerchip that was left there, which they succeeded in taking despite the Avengers interference. They also succeed in stealing all the Treasures of Darkness. When the Avengers and their partners discovered Loki's true plan and came to destroy the Dark Gate device, Tim and Joel confronted the group with their latest villains, Bi-Beast and Iron Monger. Both villains were defeated, but the Avengers could not prevent Ronin from opening the portal. However, once the portal was opened, it became clear that Dormammu and Loki had no intention of giving Tim and the other Celebrity Five members a role in their conquest of Earth, and Dormammu dragged Tim into the Dark Dimension. After both Loki and Dormammu are defeated, Tim and the other Celebrity Five members somehow escape the Dark Dimension again, and at the end of the series they are still at large. How they escaped remains unknown, but it is suggested Loki had something to do with it.

tim hacker.name: Tim Hacker
tim hacker.origin: Husband and father of two, mutant Tim Hacker worked as a children's magician. He could turn his skin a purplish hue and had an extra finger on each hand, all of his fingers long and capable of doing great card tricks. On M-Day, he lost his powers but retained his purplish skin. He was later murdered by Ghoul. A picture of Hacker's body was sent to reporter Sally Floyd. A caption on the corpse stated "Not Enough Died".

tim kelliher.name: Tim Kelliher
tim kelliher.origin: Morning Bugle editor Tim Kelliher received a distress signal on the teletype and sent his reporter Fred Byron to rescue them and get the scoop. Fred reluctantly went out into the blizzard and saved a group of people, but they were not the ones who sent the distress signal. Back at the newsroom, the same thing happened three more times, with Kelliher encouraging Fred with money and fame, and Fred braving the weather to save more people who were not the ones sending the distress signal on the teletype. When Fred finally decided not to risk the rescue attempt, Kelliher told him that there was no need as the signal was no longer coming, not knowing that the signal was coming from the Moon, which they were reporting to their rescue team.

tim rhodes.name: Tim Rhodes
tim rhodes.origin: Tim Rhodes was a mutant who came to Stony Plain, Alberta claiming to only be looking to make new friends. His appearance and abilities forced the police to treat him as a threat. Coincidentally Charles Xavier and Namor happened to be in town following rumors of a possible mutant. When Tim "made friends" with an officer, the others began to shoot at him; meanwhile, the officer struck by Tim's powers had had his DNA transumted into that of a human-animal hybrid. Charles prevented the RCMP from shooting at them as he conducted a psychic sweep of Tim's mind and found out that he was part of a government program which labeled him as subject Genus. Tim had escaped from a facility and began transforming animals into people in hopes that they could help him. Xavier saw the transformation of the cop and realized that Tim could change the species of any living creature, meaning they could use Tim's gift to accelerate mankind's evolution into mutants; however, Namor saw that Tim's powers would be used by humans as a cure for mutation instead and forcibly attempted to convince Xavier of this. Xavier lost control of one of the officers, who fired a shell from a shotgun into Tim's chest. As he lay dying in the streets he whispered to Namor that he was lonely.

tim skelly.name: Tim Skelly
tim skelly.origin: Big Tim Skelly was a crimelord who controlled Newton City, Delaware, since approximately 1916 to World War II, controlling the politicians, deciding who thrived, and being a virtual dictator of the city. By early 1941, Skelly had also made a secret deal with Heinie Myers, czar of the city's underworld, although Skelly was wary to be ever visited by Myers (apparently because Myers was a known lawbreaker while Skelly, who control the politics in the city, had to keep up a charade of respectability). thumb|left|Big Tim Skelly In 1941, Tom Douglas became the District Attorney, with Skelly's support, but Douglas was proactive against organized crime. Douglas suspected of the deal between Myers and Skelly, or at least Myers believed that, so Myers went to see Skelly in person, against Skelly's wishes, to demand Skelly to control Douglas. While angry at Myers' untimely visit, Skelly did as Myers had asked: Skelly sent hired killers to murder Douglas' political rival Daniel "Dan" Reardon, leaving behind proof that would incriminate Douglas. Douglas was arrested, and Skelly intended to push buttons so that Douglas would be sentenced to death. However, superhuman adventurer the Vision, believing in Douglas' innocence, tracked Skelly's goons and had them confess and incriminate Skelly. The Vision then went after Skelly, who at that point was celebrating with Myers: The Vision told them what he had achieved, then grabbed Myers, who asked Skelly for help before being knocked down. Skelly grabbed a gun and shot Vision, but instead hit Myers dead. The ruckus attracted the police, who immediately arrested Skelly for Myers' homicide because the Vision used his powers to vanish before the policemen could see him. Skelly was then charged with Reardon's death too, and his control over Newton City ended. Douglas was exonerated and thus, with Vision help, he unseat Skelly.

Douglas suspected of the deal between Myers and Skelly, or at least Myers believed that, so Myers went to see Skelly in person, against Skelly's wishes, to demand Skelly to control Douglas. While angry at Myers' untimely visit, Skelly did as Myers had asked: Skelly sent hired killers to murder Douglas' political rival Daniel "Dan" Reardon, leaving behind proof that would incriminate Douglas. Douglas was arrested, and Skelly intended to push buttons so that Douglas would be sentenced to death. However, superhuman adventurer the Vision, believing in Douglas' innocence, tracked Skelly's goons and had them confess and incriminate Skelly. The Vision then went after Skelly, who at that point was celebrating with Myers: The Vision told them what he had achieved, then grabbed Myers, who asked Skelly for help before being knocked down. Skelly grabbed a gun and shot Vision, but instead hit Myers dead. The ruckus attracted the police, who immediately arrested Skelly for Myers' homicide because the Vision used his powers to vanish before the policemen could see him. Skelly was then charged with Reardon's death too, and his control over Newton City ended. Douglas was exonerated and thus, with Vision help, he unseat Skelly.
weapons: Skelly was armed with a pistol.

timara.name: Timara
timara.origin: ===Origin and early years=== Timara was a dancing girl in the Thieves' Quarter of Shadizar the Wicked, Zamora, around her twenties. She was nevertheless known of higher people, and traders, priests, and even a king or two came to see her dance. Eventually, the wanderlust seized her and she joined a traveling carnival troupe that zigzagged back and forth along the border of Zamora, Corinthia and Koth. One night, the troupe camped near pre-human ruins atop Dagoth Hill, in Dark Valley. Unlike her companions, Timara reveled the strangeness of the place and went to dance madly in the ruins, until she fell asleep, exhausted. She awoke as the Demon of Dark Valley was mating with her. Twin sons were born of that union: Tsotha-Lanti was sent away with Druids, while she lived with Laza-Lanti in the Dark Valley until he left the Valley when about ten years old . She then rejoined the Demon of Dark Valley. There, she collected the cattle sacrificed by the people of Dark Valley to the Demon-Lord. ===Laza-Lanti's return=== Ten years later, Laza-Lanti returned with an ally, Conan the Cimmerian, and followed her as she led the cattle to the Demon of Dark Valley. Discovering it, Laza-Lanti attacked the monster and managed to kill it. Timara revealed the truth to Laza-Lanti, then committed suicide laying on the carcass of her lover to join the Demon a last time, in death. Shocked, Laza-Lanti committed suicide at his turn.

Roy Thomas decided to flesh out the character. In the short story, the sorcerer Pelias (Tsotha-Lanti's archenemy) mention's his foe's origin: "As for Tsotha—men say that a dancing­-girl of Shadizar slept too near the pre-human ruins on Dagoth Hill and woke in the grip of a black demon; from that unholy union was spawned an accursed hybrid men call Tsotha-lanti—"

time bot.name: Time-bot
time bot.origin: Doctor Doom built and activated this robot as a part of a plan to get Thor's hammer Mjolnir and use it to power another machine, the Time Displacer, to raid Castle Doom, then occupied by usurper Kristoff Vernard. Doom studied Thor's psychology and knew that Thor kept an eye on criminals he had personally captured; so he sent the Timebot to rescue some crooks from the police station. The robot broke the building's wall and shot policemen Vinnie Evans and Marcus Stone, sending the former to the past for a few seconds; Evans returned in shock. Further policemen came to attack the intruder, but were unable to stop the robot. When the journalists reported the event, it came to Thor's attention; Thor went to station with his ally Hercules. Doom monitored the fray and, when he saw the unexpected presence of Hercules, he decided to go there personally, joining the Timebot's side. When Doom came, the robot went to his side, and Hercules and Thor followed them, while the policemen re-captured the fugitives. Thor then hurled his hammer to the robot's chest plate, its apparent vulnerability, but the robot shot its ray and captured the hammer in the timestream. Doom and the Timebot left, having stolen the hammer. Doom and the robot went to Latveria in a vehicle with a crew of Defense Droids. Once there, Doom ordered his robots to build the Time Displacer machine, and the Timebot to leave Thor's hammer within the machine. Using the hammer's mystic energies, Doom stopped movement within the city and castle, except for people with immunity such as his robots and himself. Doom left for the castle, leaving the Defense Droids and the Timebot to protect the machine. Tracking the stolen weapon, Hercules went to Latveria along with his allies She-Hulk and architect Eric Masterson -secretly Thor's human identity at that point, who would become Thor again as soon as he could grab the hammer. The three heroes found the Time Displacer and confronted the robots there. When Masterson saw Mjolnir, he tried to grab it but was intercepted by the Timebot. Masterson pole-vaulted over the robot to grab the hammer, causing the machine to blow up, and the explosion destroyed the robot - Masterson himself survived by becoming Thor. As far as known, Doctor Doom never built another working unit of the Timebot before or after the destruction of the first one.

time buoy number 6 c.name: Time-Buoy Number 6-C
time buoy number 6 c.origin: The Tribunals were beings who considered themselves to be the antibodies of the universe. They needed to gather information on the Defenders, so they created a robot for that purpose. It was programmed with a human, feminine personality, and granted false memories. Under the identity of Luann Bloom, the robot was intended to become a companion for Nighthawk. Luann was unaware of her own status as a sleeper agent. Nighthawk was paralyzed during the daytime hours, while his powers restored his mobility during the night. Luann was hired as Nighthawk's personal nurse. She picked up her new patient from the residence of Doctor Strange. Nighthawk and Luann got properly acquainted through an hours-long conversation. Nighthawk considered her a friend. Luann was surprised when her patient vanished from a closed room, thanks to Hellcat's Shadow Cloak. Luann silently watched as several members of the Defenders chose to leave the team. She was only there to offer a ride home to Nighthawk. While Clea tried to find a mystic cure for Nighthawk's paralysis, Luann waited nearby with Wong. She later accompanied Nighthawk while he visited his ex-girlfriend Mindy Williams at a mental institution. Nighthawk got furious with August Masters' plans, and Luann tried to calm him down. Nighthawk had a meeting with his lawyers Matt Murdock and Milton Rosenblum. They discussed the legal charges against Nighthawk, while Luann acted mostly as a silent witness in the meeting. They were all shocked when the charges were suddenly dropped. August Masters claimed to have arranged for this development. Nighthawk arranged a party for the apparent end to his legal troubles. Luann attended the party, along with Murdock, Rosenblum, and some of the current members of the Defenders. Enemy agents entered interrupted the festivities, knocking everyone out with gas. They kidnapped the Defenders, with Luann unable to help her patient. Summoned by Milton Rosenblum, Luan was informed that Nighthawk was dead. The information was based on reports by S.H.I.E.L.D.. Luan was horrified and left in tears. However, she had lingering doubts about her patient's death. She vowed to find out the true circumstances of that death. Luann received a phone call from an apparent representative of S.H.I.E.L.D. He asked her to meet him on a certain street corner. The meeting was a ruse. When Luann arrived at the meeting place, she found one of the Elves with Guns waiting for her. He was there to kidnap her. Luann boarded a car with the Elf. She was surprised when the car transported them through several different dimensions of the universe. Luann did not feel afraid through their journey. But when she met one of the Tribunals and she was asked to report to him, she was confused. She had no idea who he was and what he wanted from her. The Tribunal briefly explained her status as a sleeper agent to her, but she denied it. In response, the Elf ripped off her faceplate and revealed the circuitry beneath it. Her programming took over, and Luann started narrating several stories which Nighthawk had shared with her. She even included a previously unrecorded battle between the Defenders and Yandroth. After listening to her report, the Tribunal left her inert. She was intended for transport to a storage unit. The Elf captured and transported four members of the Defenders (Doctor Strange, Hulk, Silver Surfer, and Sub-Mariner). They passed through Luann's inert form with no incident. Shortly later, Luann re-activated herself. She was angry, and she started verbally attacking the Tribunal. Another Elf with a Gun shut her down. The Defenders were informed that Luann was a robot, but Luann still considered herself to be human. The Tribunal considered her defective and ordered her destruction. One of the Elves started pulling her inert form towards a scrap heap. Her ultimate fate remains unrevealed.

The Defenders were informed that Luann was a robot, but Luann still considered herself to be human. The Tribunal considered her defective and ordered her destruction. One of the Elves started pulling her inert form towards a scrap heap. Her ultimate fate remains unrevealed.

timeshadow.name: Timeshadow
timeshadow.origin: Not much is known about the past of the mutant who would eventually call himself Timeshadow. His first recorded appearance was in the same detox center as a co-patient of mutant junkie Mike Nowlan, hospitalized to kick his addiction to heroin following the Vietnam War. What Timeshadow was in the center for remains unrevealed. Upon his first encounter with Nowlan, Nowlan's powers to boost the natural abilities of other mutants triggered Timeshadow's latent mutant abilities. Timeshadow later joined up with Apocalypse's Alliance of Evil and brought Mike in with him. Mike eventually broke free from Apocalypse's compound in California, sending Timeshadow and the other Alliance members after him. Nowlan came under the protection of X-Factor. The Alliance members clashed with X-Factor and defeated the heroes with reluctant assistance from Nowlan, whose wife Susan had been captured and used as blackmail. X-Factor tracked the Alliance back to their headquarters and clash with them again. During the fight Nowlan's powers were unleashed, causing Timeshadow to uncontrollably shift back and forth in time. Nowlan and Susan died in the battle's aftermath, and Timeshadow and the Alliance evaded capture. Laying low for a time, Timeshadow and the other Alliance members later terrorized reporter Trish Tilby during a live report, in response to the newly passed Mutant Registration Act. The villains laid low X-Factor and their young charges before they were all single-handedly defeated by the Beast. The Alliance split up after this last encounter, and Timeshadow's subsequent activities remain unrevealed.

timeslot.name: Timeslot
timeslot.origin: Timeslot was a mercenary from the Death Sponsors. They were hired to find and bring back Arize who excaped from the Mojoworld. Timeslot teleported the team to the Earth, but they ended up in Tokyo, Japan. Deadair tracked down Arize, and they teleported again directly to the X-Mansion. While his teammates were fighting with the X-Men, Timeslot managed to capture Arize. Bishop had managed to sever the link between Arize and Timeslot just as he was preparing to teleport with the team back to Mojoworld, so then the next moment they teleported away, Arize had stayed behind. Years later the Death Sponsors were hired by Gringrave, an old gladiator partner of Shatterstar. They kidnapped Shatterstar's tenants and teleported them to Mojoworld, but one of them, an elderly Dwayne Taylor from Earth-90214 had taken Timeslot by surprise and managed to stab him in the neck with a knife.

timmy glenn.name: Timmy Glenn
timmy glenn.origin: Corkscrew participated in a try-out held by X-Statix to find a replacement member for the recently deceased U-Go Girl, at the Nevada X-Statix Training Camp. He was a promising candidate, 'a rising star in the feeder leagues', and had a rep for going in where it hurt. He was qualified as a "Code X", which meant that his mutation had possibly driven him insane, and expressed extreme violence during training. He was seen kicking a green-skinned man but then used his powers to kill an opponent moments later during a session in front of the X-Statix. His case was handled by Doop as X-Statix owner Spike Freeman wanted to determine his real status. The mutant Corkscrew killed would have his death explained in a different way, as deaths during training are not popular with the public, so it would be said the mutant had died during a mission. Doop took Corkscrew out into the woods for what Corkscrew thought was a final test for X-Statix. Doop had the man filmed and his mood ranged from cheery and upbeat, to a horse-butchering, sobbing breakdown. At which point, Doop ended the man's misery, killing him with an axe and a smile.

timothy inferno baby.name: Timothy (Inferno Baby)
timothy inferno baby.origin: ===Inferno Babies=== Timmy was the child of a stock broker, Tim, and his wife, Helen, living outside of the city of New York. Using information from Cameron Hodge, thirteen mutant children (including Timmy) were kidnapped by N'astirh's N'asteris, during the Inferno. The infants arrived in a cemetery, where the demon N'astirh was attempting to create a permanent portal open between the demon infested dimension of Limbo and Earth. The infants were teleported to Times Square, where the New Mutant, Magik, was opening a portal to return her teammates from Limbo and N'astirh, using 10 of the babies as the points of an inverted pentagram (focusing beams of power because of their purity and openness to use them as natural, living conduits who could not block the flow of power and who would not know how to shut it off), kept the portal open. N'astirh attempted to used them, and baby Christopher Summers, who later grew-up to become Cable, to open a portal from Limbo to Earth and was partially successful in merging the two realms. The X-Terminators and the New Mutants rescued the babies from the pentacle. After the defeat of N'astirh, the Goblin Queen attempted to sacrifice baby Christopher and the other three mutant babies atop the Empire State Building to finish N'astirh's work and permanently open a gateway between Earth and Limbo. The invasion was thwarted after the Goblin Queen committed suicide in combat with Marvel Girl, attempting to kill everyone in her power. After the X-Terminators and New Mutants took the babies to X-Factor's Celestial Ship, X-Factor turned the babies over to the US government, while being attacked by Nanny and Orphan-Maker. ===Project Purgatory=== For many years the fate of children remained unknown. Following the Inferno, the United States Army founded Project Purgatory to research the fields of the supernatural and paranormal. One of the recruited scientists, Doctor Noc, developed technology to use the children to open portals to Limbo. General Ulysses, Doctor Noc, and a trained band of military soldiers established a military base in Limbo, the Hatchery. At the base, they continued to experiment, both on demons and on the Inferno babies, and train new soldiers. However, when the soldiers recovered the Bloodstone amulet, the base was attacked by Witchfire and the Inferno babies were believed dead. The Earth based military forces sealed off the portal Epsilon, leaving those on the Limbo base stranded to find the observation portal with virtually no hope of escape. After 26 years in Limbo, but only 4 years on Earth, Noc and Ulysses were able to locate a traveling portal and return home, keeping the existence of the children to themselves. However, they never gave up their mission of taking control of Limbo and capturing Illyana Rasputin. They returned to a world where all of the mutants were living together, on Utopia. and, therefore, their commanding officer, General Combest, ordered them to stand-down. The unit still believed that Illyana was a significant threat and, after Project Purgatory kidnapped Pixie, the Inferno Babies revealed themselves when they killed General Combest and obliterated the entire battalion. The New Mutants showed to rescue Pixie and the Inferno Babies defeated them. After Dr. Noc and General Ulysses took Illyana's Soulsword and Pixie's Souldagger, they extracted the Bloodstones and completed the Bloodstone Amulet to call forth the Elder Gods. They, along with members of Project Purgatory, tortured the New Mutants. While attempting to transport the New Mutants to Limbo, to be used as sacrifices for the Elder Gods, Karma showed Face what Project Purgatory had done to him and he killed Timothy, Maw, and members of Project Purgatory and freed Magik and Karma.

Following the Inferno, the United States Army founded Project Purgatory to research the fields of the supernatural and paranormal. One of the recruited scientists, Doctor Noc, developed technology to use the children to open portals to Limbo. General Ulysses, Doctor Noc, and a trained band of military soldiers established a military base in Limbo, the Hatchery. At the base, they continued to experiment, both on demons and on the Inferno babies, and train new soldiers. However, when the soldiers recovered the Bloodstone amulet, the base was attacked by Witchfire and the Inferno babies were believed dead. The Earth based military forces sealed off the portal Epsilon, leaving those on the Limbo base stranded to find the observation portal with virtually no hope of escape. After 26 years in Limbo, but only 4 years on Earth, Noc and Ulysses were able to locate a traveling portal and return home, keeping the existence of the children to themselves. However, they never gave up their mission of taking control of Limbo and capturing Illyana Rasputin. They returned to a world where all of the mutants were living together, on Utopia. and, therefore, their commanding officer, General Combest, ordered them to stand-down. The unit still believed that Illyana was a significant threat and, after Project Purgatory kidnapped Pixie, the Inferno Babies revealed themselves when they killed General Combest and obliterated the entire battalion. The New Mutants showed to rescue Pixie and the Inferno Babies defeated them. After Dr. Noc and General Ulysses took Illyana's Soulsword and Pixie's Souldagger, they extracted the Bloodstones and completed the Bloodstone Amulet to call forth the Elder Gods. They, along with members of Project Purgatory, tortured the New Mutants. While attempting to transport the New Mutants to Limbo, to be used as sacrifices for the Elder Gods, Karma showed Face what Project Purgatory had done to him and he killed Timothy, Maw, and members of Project Purgatory and freed Magik and Karma.

timothy anders.name: Timothy Anders
timothy anders.origin: Timothy Anders was the son of a homeless alcoholic woman named Gretl Anders. During a blizzard, Gretl with the assistance of fellow alcoholic Tony Stark gave birth to her son in New York City. Shortly after holding him for the first time, Gretl perished, leaving the child in the care of Stark. They were eventually found by rescue workers who took both of them to a hospital. The newborn child was then sent to an orphanage in Bowery where he was given the name Timothy by the nuns. As part of his plan to strike back against Stark, Obadiah Stane had minions kidnap Timothy, alongside other people close to Stark. Stark tried to prevent the kidnapping, but because he didn't have access to his armor, there was little he could do to stop it. Taken to the headquarters of Stane International, Timothy, Mrs. Arbogast, Happy Hogan and Pepper Potts were put in suspended animation cells which were rigged with circuits that could instantly kill anyone inside. Stark in his Silver Centurion Armor fought Stane in his own Iron Monger Armor, but as he was losing the battle, Stane brought to Stark to his captives and threatened him with Timothy's life. After getting his friends out of their cells, Stark took control of the Iron Monger's control unit, knocking Stane out and rescuing Timothy. Stark handed the infant to a nearby firefighter, telling him to take care of the child while he went back to fight Stane. Growing in the orphanage, Tim learned early on to protect himself and fight back against bullies. With a Stark scholarship, he enrolled in a prestigious school. One day, Tim noticed a group of kids beating a defenseless Normie Osborn and quickly intervened. Beating up the bullies, Tim helped Normie get back on his feet and gave him his uniform jacket since Normie's had been ruined. Befriending each other, Tim told Normie how bullies were like sharks which immediately attacked as soon as they smelled blood, giving Normie an idea to how to rescue his grandfather Norman, who had been kidnapped by the Goblin Nation. After Normie left to rescue his grandfather, Tim was interrogated by the principal over Normie's absence, but the boy attempted to cover it up in order to not get his new friend in trouble.

timothy braverman.name: Timothy Braverman
timothy braverman.origin: According to his own words (which may have been false), Tim Braverman grew up in a poor family in Brooklyn with his younger brother. Their mother "worked for a living," possibly dishonorably, while their alcoholic father spent the money that came in and beat Braverman when he wasn't too drunk. Braverman and his younger brother learned to shoplift in order to obtain basic goods such as milk. They developed a ruse where the younger brother would attract the attention of the shopkeeper by pretending to steal, and when the keeper and the authorities were distracted by him, Tim Braverman himself would make off with the loot. However, on one such occasion, an inebriated off-duty policeman shot and killed Tim Braverman's brother, even though the shopkeeper would have forgiven him. Enraged, Tim Braverman vowed to stop being poor and ridiculing the authorities in order to avenge his brother. Braverman moved to the West Coast, where he spent years working, studying, planning and executing crimes, eventually becoming the criminal mastermind Gamesman, whom other criminals paid to plan their hits. From an underground sanctum called the Situation Room, the Gamesman met with his associates, always hiding his face behind a hood. The Gamesman obtained confidential information on locations to rob, from alarm systems to guard schedules, and sometimes even developed custom technology to carry out the hit. The Gamesman had also assembled an intricate network of criminal contacts to help him obtain illegal resources, such as fake IDs; and even had the Los Angeles Police Headquarters' cleaner, Marsha, on his payroll so that she'd phone in information she could overhear. Finally, the Gamesman had collected ten million dollars worth of stolen diamonds, which he stored in a safety deposit vault at Los Angeles Bank and Trust Company, but very few people knew about his "insurance". The Gamesman's hits had the Los Angeles Police Department baffled, and bounties began to be placed on the capture of the Gamesman and his associates, and for the return of the goods he'd stolen. The Gamesman carefully planned a robbery of modern art paintings at the Los Angeles County Art Museum for a client named Charlie, and as usual, the police had no leads: LAPD Jacobi put detectives Harris and Stevens on the case, and informed his boss, Captain Alexander Walsh. By then, superheroine Spider-Woman had just begun a career as a bounty hunter in Los Angeles with the help of criminologist Scotty McDowell, delivering caught criminals to Walsh. Immediately after apprehending serial murderer Killer Clown, Spider-Woman captured the museum thieves and, along with the stolen paintings, delivered them to Walsh in his office, neither of them knowing that Marsha was informing the Gamesman on this. The Gamesman, knowing that Spider-Woman had foiled his heist and might do it again, wanted to take action against her by pretending to be her friend: He sent five of his thugs, including Bonzo and Rufus to ambush her as she left the station through an alley, hoping that she would be overwhelmed by their sheer numbers, and then Braverman would appear, unmasked, to help her escape, his car ready, thus gaining her trust. Braverman made an excuse for being there, claiming to be a Los Angeles Times reporter lurking around the station looking for a scoop on the Gamesman; he then flattered her, claiming he recognized her by reputation, and even offered first aid for her work. Spider-Woman, reasonably suspicious, asked to be left on the ground, but Braverman still insisted on inviting her to a picnic the next day in the country. When Spider-Woman reported what happened to McDowell, he asked for more details, and she believed he was jealous (which he was). McDowell wanted Spider-Woman to look for more clues about the Gamesman, but she decided to go to rest, determined to keep the date with Braverman. Following this encounter, the Gamesman was able to inform his clients that he had already begun taking steps to ensure that Spider-Woman would not interfere with his plans again. His next plan was to rob the Rajah Ruby from an international gem exhibit at the Civic Auditorium for the benefit of a criminal group in Detroit, using a chemical foam specifically developed by the Gamesman himself to silence the alarms, and with his people ready to knock out the guards with gas guns. One of the Gamesman's men, Momo, spoke of this at a gangland nightclub, unaware that Spider-Woman was spying on him disguised as a waitress. During the picnic, Spider-Woman told Braverman about the tip about the Rajah Ruby theft. Braverman attempted to convince Spider-Woman not to go there, first suggesting that the Gamesman might have another plan, and then saying that it could be dangerous. He then kissed her, beginning a romantic relationship. timothy byrnes.name: Timothy Byrnes
timothy byrnes.origin: Timothy Byrnes was the best student at his school and the captain of the school's football team. After graduation, he and his wife got married and they had a son while in college. Having always had the dream of being a lawyer, having to deal with the responsibilities of a son while still in college, made his academic life very difficult. This led to him and Gayle starting to argue, and their marriage became unstable. When she got pregnant again, Timothy left her because he couldn't cope with the thought of another child.

timothy cababa.name: Timothy Cababa
timothy cababa.origin: Once a constructor for the Triumph Division, after he quit, he was hired by Tony Stark in his new company Stark Resilient. When Tony Stark revamped his company into Stark Resilient, Justine Hammer hired Spymaster to sabotage him. To this end, Spymaster assumed the identity of Leonard Pimacher. During this time, he developed a relationship with Tim Cababa, and came to love him truthfully. Spymaster saw himself forced to attack Tim when ordered to blow his cover, but avoided killing him.

timothy carney.name: Timothy Carney
timothy carney.origin: Timothy Carneywas the brother of Patrick Carney, the superhero known as the Yankee Clipper, and followed his example in becoming a superhero himself, calling himself Kid Justice. Both brothers were members of the superhero team known as the First Line. Growing up after the apparent death of his brother, Kid Justice became Mister Justice and participated in many missions for the team, but lost his life on their final mission, when they fought off a Skrull invasion in Earth's orbit. Mister Justice was distracted by the arrival of the time traveller Cassandra Locke, who was wearing his brother's time travel belt. When Mister Justice demanded she tell him where she got the belt, he was shot in the back by a Skrull warrior, killing him.

timothy chambers.name: Timothy Chambers
timothy chambers.origin: Nothing is known about Timothy, save that he had a son named Jonathan, who would one day become the mutant villain Empyrean, and that he himself was a mutant whose mutation rapidly aged him; by early middle age, he resembled a frail old man in need of a walker. When his son was thirteen, Timothy was killed in a car accident related to his rapid aging. This incident caused Jonathan to work toward a dream of creating a "utopia" for mutants in need, recruiting them by force if necessary.

timothy dugan.origin: ===Early Life=== Timothy Aloysius Cadwallader "Dum Dum" Dugan was born and raised in Boston, Massachusetts. He was born into a poor family of Irish immigrants. At the young age of 14 he joined the circus as a strongman and part-time prizefighter to make money. He was on tour in England on the lead-up to World War II. ===World War II=== In early 1941, Dugan was traveling with the circus through Europe. In the Netherlands, Dugan first met Nick Fury, the man who would become his closest friend, who was then a performer in a stunt flying act and parachute instructor. Dugan helped Fury and Sam Sawyer escape the Nazis during a mission. Dugan later joined the British Army. ===The Howling Commandos=== When Sawyer was charged with creating Fury's First Attack Squad, also known as the Howling Commandos, Sawyer invited Dugan to become second-in-command. After training, the unit was dispatched back behind enemy lines in France to recover Free French resistance fighter who was captured by Nazi soldiers. This was a vital rescue mission, since they knew the date and time of an impending Allied landing on the beaches of Normandy. With the help of Free French resistance fighters, they rescued the man from the Nazis before he could be forced to talk. His exceptional strength saved the day in several of his adventures with the group. During his time with the Howlers, Dugan became skilled in all Allied small weapons and gained experience in all forms of hand to hand combat, especially Judo. With his trademark derby, Dum Dum frequently struck fear into the Nazi and Japanese enemies in mission after mission. The Howling Commandos were so feared by the Third Reich that a counter-squad of elite fighters, the Blitzkrieg Squad, was formed, and among their number barroom brawler Siegfried, whose story of defeating six men with his bare hands made it to the ears of Baron Strucker, was chosen to stand against Dum Dum Dugan. After seeing combat in a French coastal town, Fury was called back to base where he was informed that the Nazis were getting ahead in the race to develop an atomic bomb. Posing as sailors, the Howling Commandos managed to smuggle their way into Germany to seek out the laboratory in the town of Heinemund, where the atomic weapons were being developed. Initially Dugan was captured by the Nazis and the rest of the Howling Commandos attempted to free him, but they realized the only way that they could get near the lab was to allow themselves to be captured and placed into a nearby concentration camp. Breaking free, Fury and his Commandos attacked the Germany laboratory, sabotaging the scientists' work there. After they fled, the exposed rods of nuclear material reached critical mass and destroyed the lab in a massive nuclear explosion. It is possible that this setback is what caused Nazi leader Adolf Hitler to call off any further development of atomic weapons. Among the foes Dum Dum squared off against was Colonel Klaue, stepping in for Fury on a one-on-one match with the iron-handed officer. Following this incident, Dugan was brought up on court martial charges, but Fury soon revealed that it was a plot by the Agent of 1,000 Faces. Perhaps one of his most daring moments was his face off against the Sea Shark, during which he led a group of prisoners to take over the German ship. Foreshadowing his future experiences in S.H.I.E.L.D., Dugan also faced a number of supernatural and superhuman menaces during the war, including Baron Blood. Dugan had many opportunities to take command of the Howlers himself. On one occasion, trapped behind enemy lines during Allied bombings of a German town, Dum Dum took command and led a demoralized team back across heavily fortified enemy territory with a wounded Fury in tow. ===The Deadly Dozen=== His experience with the Howlers led to Dugan being assigned to train the similar task force known as the "Deadly Dozen" by Sawyer. Promoted to sergeant, Dugan along with fellow Howlers Pinkerton and Maneli trained and fought alongside the Dozen on their first missions. Dugan was reassigned to the Howlers just prior to the Battle of the Bulge, where he fought alongside not only his Howler teammates, but also both the Deadly Dozen with their new commander and Captain America and Bucky. ===1950s=== Like the rest of the Howling Commandos, Dugan re-enlisted in the army when the United States entered the war in Korea in 1950s. timothy harrison.name: Timothy Harrison
timothy harrison.origin: Tim Harrison was a terminally ill child who was a huge fan of Spider-Man. An article published in a newspaper caught Peter's attention and decided to visit the child at the Slocum Brewer Cancer Clinic. Spider-Man told Tim about his origin, his web-shooters, and took him to one of his night patrols. Peter even revealed his secret identity to Tim. Later, Harrison succumbed to the illness. His brother Joey was grateful to Spider-Man for showing such kindness to Tim before he died.

fields.notes: His brother, Joey, a patient at a hospital, later defended Spider-Man's actions to J. Jonah Jameson when he wanted Spider-Man to leave the hospital.
fields.trivia: Tim Harrison was the basis for the character of Taina Elizando in the 1994 animated series, a similarly terminally ill child who wished to meet Spider-Man. Spider-Man would later visit another one of his biggest fans who was diagnosed with cancer by the name of Nathan, though unlike with Tim he wouldn't reveal his identity to the boy.

timothy hersberger.name: Timothy Hersberger
timothy hersberger.origin: Red Corker was a notorious killer and crime boss who was active in the San Francisco area in the 1940's until locked away in jail. However, during a prison riot, he escaped and returned to his old turf, setting up a hideout in the long abandoned Dream Island and continuing his criminal operations. The FBI sent their agent Dale Sturm to capture him. Corker had his men attempt to eliminate Sturm, an attempt what would apparently be a complete success. However, Dale survived, and after Red kidnapped the daughter of wealthy oil magnate George Dean, Dale tracked Corker to his hideout. There, Dale shot Corker dead, and his men were soon apprehended afterward.

timothy jones.name: Timothy Jones
timothy jones.origin: Nothing has been revealed about the past of Timothy Jones. Jones lived in a small shack in the woods with his lame daughter, Cathy. On the night of his daughter's eighth birthday, while walking in the woods, Jones found a pink doll in the tall grass. Not being able to afford a present for Cathy, Jones took the doll and gave it to her. Cathy grew attached to the doll and began telling her father that the doll could walk and talk on its own, but Jones simply brushed her claims off as fantasy. One night, the doll snuck out of the house. While it was checking to see if Jones was asleep, Jones woke up. The doll used hypnosis to put Jones back to sleep and snuck out the front door. The next morning, Jones woke up to find that Cathy was walking under her own power. Cathy told Jones that the doll was gone, but that she had found a solid brick of gold under her pillow. Jones looks up at the sky and wondered aloud what really happened and why.

timothy mulrooney.name: Timothy Mulrooney
timothy mulrooney.origin: left|thumb|As Tim A former student of Steve Jordan, he was there while Jordan sought the formula for the 'Wonder Fluid', a means of granting men increased resilience and strength. Knocking over some test tubes, a gas was released, knocking Jordan out while Tim managed to open an window. The gas granted them superpowers and they fought crime during the 1940s. When Captain Wonder disappeared, Tim continued as "Captain Tim, The Scourge of Crime", but he realized his powers were slowly fading. Eventually, in the 1960s, he retired from crime-fighting and opened an electronics store. He no longer felt "special" and this became something of an obsession. His aging slowed, he was still alive when Captain Wonder was discovered and revived. He begged Wonder to give him the formula for the Wonder Fluid in the hopes it might help with his advanced cancer, but Jordan had no ability to do so. With his last hope dashed, Tim stormed off while cursing his one-time mentor. Tim was last seen with his old cape leaping off a rooftop, presumably to his death.

When Captain Wonder disappeared, Tim continued as "Captain Tim, The Scourge of Crime", but he realized his powers were slowly fading. Eventually, in the 1960s, he retired from crime-fighting and opened an electronics store. He no longer felt "special" and this became something of an obsession. His aging slowed, he was still alive when Captain Wonder was discovered and revived. He begged Wonder to give him the formula for the Wonder Fluid in the hopes it might help with his advanced cancer, but Jordan had no ability to do so. With his last hope dashed, Tim stormed off while cursing his one-time mentor. Tim was last seen with his old cape leaping off a rooftop, presumably to his death.

tina deacon.name: Tina Deacon
tina deacon.origin: Detective Deacon was with her partner, Detective Ed Taylor as they responded to the scene of a supposed beating of Pistol Pat Albano by the vigilante Daredevil. As she was about to make her report, Taylor told her to not further investigate the situation as it would be a waste of paperwork as Mayor Fisk was gung-ho about the capture of heroes within the city. Deacon was about to wrap things up until the arrival of another patrol car. Detective Cole North stepped out of the vehicle and started his own questioning which angered Taylor. Cole asked Deacon about what happened and she answered that the victim only heard something and had no visual to go on. He then explained that he will write a report showing that Deacon was coerced by Taylor to obfuscate the perp's identity. She said she wanted to report it but explained that Taylor was against it.

tina minoru.name: Tina Minoru
tina minoru.origin: ===Origins=== Tina Minoru and her husband Robert were dark wizards for a long lineage of warlocks. ===The Pride=== One the day of their wedding, the couple was summoned by the Gibborim to be the "The Magicians" in the Pride with promises of power, wealth, and eternal life. 200px|thumb|left|Tina and Robert Minoru (Earth-616)|Robert being summoned by the [[Gibborim]] 300px|thumb|left|Tina and Robert Minoru (Earth-616)|Robert battling Doctor Strange As members of the Pride, the Minorus used their dark arts to assist in ruling the Los Angeles underworld, sacrificing to the Gibborim, protecting their turf, and disposing of threats to their power for a quarter of a century. The Minorus also had several connections within the black magic community. At some point, the Minorus obtained the Black Mirror from Marie Laveau. Curious about their ancestry, they used the Black Mirror to explore the heritage of clan Minoru. Terrified by what they found, they used blood magic to seal the mirror. Tina and Robert died in the Marine Vivarium with the other members of the Pride during the failed Rite of Thunder. Their last act was to distract the Gibborim allowing Nico and the others to escape. 200px|right|thumb|Tina and Robert Minoru (Earth-616)|Robert honing their magic

tindly hardlesnop.name: Tindly Hardlesnop
tindly hardlesnop.origin: Tindly Hardlesnop was the top builder of the Brundlebuds, and one of the millions saved by the Silver Surfer when he stabilized their sun. While for most Brundlebuds things went back to normal after a while of praising the Surfer, Hardlesnop's love for him grew with each passing day. He focused his passion into building the Brundleboost Wonder-Suit, with which he left the planet to search for the Silver Surfer. thumb|left The miniature adventurer eventually crossed paths with his hero, and requested to become his helard, or as he misinterpreted it, his "Harold." Because of this, Tindly became the Surfer's second companion next to Dawn Greenwood, and became known as "Tiny Harold." Tiny Harold was crucial in helping his friends defeat several foes, including Cap'n Sharr, the mad mechanical moon of Mobos, and Blastaar, in each occasion using his small size to his advantage. Harold also showed his bravery when he set out to defeat the gigantic Null-Set, even though said creature was the size of a nebula. Hardlesnop left the Surfer and Dawn's side when they came across a miniature planet named Zeebie inhabited by creatures so small the Surfer couldn't detect them without enhancing his cosmic senses. After saving them from the collision of mote of space dust, which was equivalent to a meteor for them, Tindly decided to remain by their side and become their guardian and champion, knowing that as daunting and lonely said task was, it was a noble one. As they bid farewell, the Surfer promised Harold they would never forget him, and would also tell his tales.

When the Skrull forces were invading Earth, Captain Britain was killed by them while trying to stop their invasion of Otherworld. tinkerbelle.name: Tinkerbelle
tinkerbelle.origin: Tinkerbelle was a Captain for one of the gladiator teams of the Royalist Forces controlled by the Elite. As ordered by Cheer Chadwick, she knocked down and captured Captain America and Falcon to attempt to turn them into serviceable arena combatants . As Captain America's Shield was stolen by one of the gladiators, Tinkerbelle offered Cap and Falcon a chance to regain it, as long as they would both participate in the Kill-Derby contest under her command . When the superheroes refused to take the gold for winning the death game, thereby forfeiting the game, Tinkerbelle and her team turned against them and attacked them in rage .

tinky weissman.name: Tinky Weissman
tinky weissman.origin: Tinky Weissman was an old friend of Janet van Dyne, otherwise known as the Avenger the Wasp. Janet had attended Tinky's coming-out party. Van Dyne ran into Tinky when she was vacationing in the Caribbean during a leave of absence from the Avengers. While at the Utopia Cay resort, Tinky introduced van Dyne to her new friend Walther Theodoric. Later, van Dyne ran into Tinky again while she was with her date 'Paul Denning' (actually the super-powered mercenary Paladin). Tinky invited the pair to a party on Theodoric's yacht. However van Dyne discovered Theodoric was actually the criminal Baron Brimstone, who planned to rob the resort's casino, and she and Paladin put a stop to his plans.

tiny.origin: "Tiny" was the alias used by a man from Bronx, who was a bad influence on young Jake Weal. He was given a thousand dollars to introduce Jake to Dr. Lucien Geist, a surgeon involved in human trafficking operations, granting different teenagers with cosmetic modifications like horns, wings or tentacles to make them exotic. After Jake's death due to an infection from a procedure that granted him wings, Tiny was interrogated by S.H.I.E.L.D agents Mockingbird and Phil Coulson, and he was forced to give vital information that helped the agents get to Dr. Geist.

tippy toe.name: Tippy-Toe
tippy toe.species: Tree Squirrel partner of Squirrel Girl
tippy toe.origin: ===Origins=== After Monkey Joe was murdered by Leather Boy, Squirrel Girl recruited an army of local squirrels to aid the Great Lakes Avengers in battling Maelstrom and Batroc's Brigade. All of the squirrels died except for Tippy-Toe, who became Squirrel Girl's new permanent partner. thumb|200px|left|Doreen Green (Earth-616)|Squirrel Girl meeting and naming Tippy-Toe ===Great Lakes Avengers=== Tippy-Toe assisted Squirrel Girl on several adventures including defeating M.O.D.O.K. when she scratched his face and disabled his Doomsday Chair and disarming Thanos. Because he failed to collect the soul of Monkey Joe, Deathurge was left trapped in the form of a squirrel for months. To escape his squirrel form, Deathurge offered to murder Tippy-Toe and bring her soul to Oblivion. However, this proved to be more difficult then Deathurge planned because Tippy-Toe continually evaded his traps. When Speedball visited the University of Wisconsin, Squirrel Girl went to meet him but instead, she ended up fighting Bug-Eyed Voice who tried to attack Speedball. Fortunately, Tippy-Toe contacted Speedball's manager and had him meet Squirrel Girl at the GLX headquarters. During a visit to New York City, Squirrel Girl and Tippy-Toe helped The Thing defeat Bi-Beast in Central Park. ===New York City=== When Squirrel Girl decided to leave the G.L.A. and return to New York City, Tippy-Toe moved with her. With Doreen enrolled as a computer science student at Empire State University, Tippy-Toe continued to aid Squirrel Girl in her superheroics. Tippy-Toe accompanied Squirrel Girl to the Moon to confront Galactus and also visited Nutopia XXIV with them. thumb|200px|left|Tippy-Toe leading a squirrel army against Samuel Smithers (Earth-616)|Plantman Although Tippy-Toe was Squirrel Girl's partner, she also continued to have her own adventures. During Squirrel Girl's adventure with Howard the Duck, Tippy-Toe was on vacation. Once, while Squirrel Girl was studying, Tippy-Toe teamed up with Rocket Raccoon to save Central Park from Plantman. Tippy-Toe refused to side with Squirrel Girl's evil clone when she wanted to rid the world of humans. Later, she nearly sacrificed her life to save Doreen when she was sent to the Moon by Allene. During a Halloween party costume contest M.C.'d by Squirrel Girl, Leather Boy, the murderer of Monkey Joe, showed up. Leather Boy, still thirsty for revenge against Squirrel Girl for joining the G.L.A., tried to kill Tippy-Toe. Fortunately, Deadpool was also in attendance and saved Tippy. Later, Deadpool left Leather Boy tied up in a tree to be attacked by squirrels. thumb|200px|right|Tippy-Toe as the Silver Squirrel imbued with a portion of the [[Power Cosmic]] Searching from a way to defeat Galactus, the Chtty and the Chrrt-chuks abducted Tippy-Toe (and Nancy Whitehead by mistake) and placed into a simulation to trick them into revealing the secrets of Galactus's defeat. It was discovered that Chrrt-chuks were actually being extorted by a fake Silver Surfer. Gaining a small portion of the Power Cosmic, Tippy-Toe tried to punish the grifters, but when she was outwitted, she gave the Power Cosmic to Nancy instead.

tirade.origin: Tirade was a Nuhuman who had her sonic manipulation powers activated by the Terrigen Cloud. She was using her abilities at a grocery store which led to a group of Hydra agents being called in to capture her. One of these was Agent Bob, who along with another attempted to go to roof and swing in from harnesses to get her but it caused an explosion which threw Bob to the side of the building. Tirade saw Bob outside the window and started to scream at him some more which triggered all the bricks in the wall to explode knocking her out in the process.

tiresias.name: Tiresias
tiresias.first_appearance: Marvel Classics Comics Series Featuring Vol 1 18: The Odyssey
tiresias.origin: ===Origin=== Tiresias was born and raised in the city of Thebes in ancient Greece. He was the son of a shepherd and a Nymph. thumb|left|250px Tiresias stumbled upon goddess Athena while she was bathing; as a result, the goddess decided to blind him. His mother begged Athena to lift the curse, but she refused to. Instead, she opened Tiresias' ears so he might hear all the whispers of the Gods. This two curses/gifts gave him a greater perspective of the world. He was traveling one day and found a pair of snakes in his path and killed them. Hera was angry at his action and decided to change his sex. As a woman, Tiresias served as a priestess of Hera. ===Hercules=== After the young baby Hercules killed the two snakes sent to kill him his parents Amphitryon and Alcmena went to Tiresias for advice. He revealed the truth of Hercules true parentage and that Zeus created him to be the champion of mankind. He saw his many future battles including one against the Hulk. ===Death=== When Tiresias died, their soul went to Hades, the Underworld, where they were visited by Odysseus who was on his ten year journey home known as the Odyssey. They gave him advice on how to continue on his voyage to Ithaca. ===Across the Ages=== At some point they returned to the land of the living as an immortal prophet. In 1782, they crashed at 's place during the time "Die Entführung aus dem Serail" had just opened to rave reviews. They enjoyed his many parties. She was also close friends of Ludwig van Beethoven and they had an interesting relationship as he/she was blind and he was deaf. This lead to an interesting confrontation with the Mayor of Vienna a story he/she still tells to this day. During the late 19th Century they got locked in the meat locker of famed French chef and restaurateur . They had never enjoyed such a good meal in all her long life. During the 1970s Tiresias lived in England where they picked up a cockney accent. They were in the studio when David Bowie recorded the "Low Album". ===Modern Era=== In the modern era they moved to the United States of America and opened a clock repair shop in New York City. They lived there with their dog Alfred Lord Tennyson. Hercules went to meet with Tiresias to ask for help and information of the Uprising Storm. They told him she would investigate, but as he left, they warned him about some "Lads" being in town and he would meet them in Central Park. As they were investigating the Uprising Storm they arrived the clock repair shop. They were beaten half to death and when Hercules came to visit them in the hospital they told him that they saw a vision just before the Uprising attacked them. They said Athena had come to claim him and take him back to Olympus, telling him his long tenure on Earth was over, that the world was changing and there's no place in it for him anymore. Horrorscope came to the hospital to finish them off but was interrupted by Sophia who had come for a visit. Horrorscope took the form of a doctor and left them in peace. Hercules invited Tiresias and the others back to his apartment where they shared dinner together toasting the battle. They shared their many stories of the famous people they had met in their long life. ===Gods of War=== After another defeat in battle, Tiresias and the others convinced Hercules to form a team of godly heroes to defeat the new gods. Hercules contacted his friends from across the globe for a meeting of the "Gods of War". He brought them to New York City to battle the Uprising Storm, but before the meeting could end the Uprising Storm attacked.

titan.name: Titan
titan.origin: thumb|left Titan was a member of the Imperial Guard, a multi-special group of super-powered alien beings who acted as enforcers of the laws of the Shi'ar Empire. Titan was amongst the first of the Imperial Guard encountered by the team of superhuman mutant adventurers known as the X-Men who sought to rescue the Princess-Majestrix Lilandra from her insane brother, then-Majesty D'Ken. Following the orders of their emperor, the Guard clashed with the X-Men and were on the verge of winning when the band of interstellar freebooters known as the Starjammers arrived to turn the tide of battle in the X-Men's favor. During Vulcan's rampage through the Shi'ar Empire, the Imperial Guard are forced to engage him on one of the Shi'ar moons. He was beaten but survived. He was later one of the numerous Imperial Guard casualties during their attack on the Cancerverse through the Fault and was killed by a swarm of mutated bugs during their final encounter.

titan atlantean beast.name: Titan (Atlantean Beast)
titan atlantean beast.species: Member of an unidentified aquatic subspecies, possibly Atlantean
titan atlantean beast.origin: Titan was a member of an unidentified race who claimed to be from Atlantis, he came to the surface somewhere in the United States to seek information about the weaponry humanity had in exchange for wealth and power. When no one would give him the answer, John Cartwright said he would reveal all Titan wished to know. Taking him back to the underseas kingdom, Titan threatened that if he lied Cartwright would die. Upon reaching the city, Cartwright lied and made out that humanity had far greater weapons than it actually possessed, which Titan believed and cancelled the invasion, killing Cartwright. Titan later resurfaced on the French coast, but was subdued by Hank Pym's Avengers and G.R.A.M.P.A who subdued him with a salt solution that dehydrated him and was taken away unconscious.

titanis.name: Titanis
titanis.first_appearance: Marvel Super Hero Contest of Champions Vol 1 1
titanis.origin: Titanis is one of the 100 Eternals who were created on Earth one million years ago by the First Host of the alien Celestials. During the Contest of Champions, she, Ikaris, Ajak and Sersi were flying high above the Andes Mountains when all four of them were teleported off-planet by the Grandmaster who was choosing champions from among the ranks of Earth's heroes in his game against Death. However, none of the abducted Eternals, including Titanis, were chosen to participate in the actual contest. Years later, Titanis was part of a team of Eternals led by Zuras who worked alongside the High Evolutionary to defend his Arctic Base from the New Warriors. Alongside her kin, she battled the New Warriors until Justice was able to convince Zuras that he had been misled into believing that the Celestials' judgement of humanity was imminent. Their alliance with the High Evolutionary no longer necessary, Titanis and the other Eternals abandoned the fight. Like all of the Eternals, Titanis died after the Final Host arrived but was resurrected by the Machine a few months later.

titannus.name: Titannus
titannus.origin: Originally, Titannus was a Skrull who, lacking shape-shifting abilities, became one of the subjects of the Super-Skrull project, giving him enhanced strength and a healing factor that would allow him to recover from any wound. After that, he rampaged leading to the destruction of cities and the crippling of people. Leaving his world, he landed on a war hungry planet and was attacked and defeated by servants of the alien king. He was used as a gladiator and in retaliation killed the King in his sleep. He took over the planet and started to invade other planets. He successfully conquered most of the galaxy until he attempted to invade the Trellion world and his army was wiped out. He made a deal with the Trellion King and was treated, like a member of the royal family. He fell in love with Amissa, but she did not return the love. One day, he nearly killed the king who fled into the wilderness. The king returned and overthrew Titannus, deciding to use him as a weapon against the heroes of Earth. After brainwashing him with a story that presented him as a victim, he travelled to Earth with Amissa in stasis in his ship as part of his new conviction that they were in love. Having 'escaped' the Trellions, Titannus crash-landed on Earth. His spacecraft crash landing in Japan, Titannus observed the heroes of Earth for several months until he was confronted by Sunfire, Japan's premiere superhero. Sunfire attempts to fight Titannus, but he was overwhelmed and nearly beaten to death. Titannus then travels to Tokyo when he was confronted by Sunfire and the Japanese army. However, Sunfire was defeated again, and countless soldiers of the Japanese army were killed. Titannus then attempted to get the 'attention' of Earth's heroes by destroying Tokyo. Sensing the disturbance, Doctor Strange assembled a new team of unofficial Defenders to oppose the alien, consisting of Spider-Man, the Hulk, Wolverine, She-Hulk, Ms. Marvel, and Nova. Titannus attempted to win them over to his side by recounting the fake story he had been brainwashed with, presenting him as a man who had overcome great odds and had come to Earth seeking aid in attacking Trellia so that he could find a cure for the 'ill' Amissa, claiming that he had merely lost his temper when attacked by Sunfire. However, Doctor Strange sensed little truth in Titannus' words, and Spider-Man stated that they did not help someone who blew up a city just because he had a tragic story to tell them. Despite their best efforts, however, the gathered heroes were unable to stop Titannus, who displayed enough power to defeat even the Hulk with ease by absorbing the gamma radiation. When Amissa was awakened by Strange and Nova, she denounced him as a lunatic- it was later speculated that she was outraged that their plan had failed- and Titannus, having been so dependent on his love for her, was driven to suicide by her rejection, apparently killing himself by crushing his own head. Having heard Titannus mentioned by the recently dimensionally-displaced Iron Maniac, Spider-Man arranged to visit the other Stark with Wolverine and Nick Fury, where they learned about Titannus' actions in Stark's world. However, his healing factor was so advanced that it allowed Titannus to grow a new head, although he appeared to suffer from total amnesia, most likely due to his development of a completely new brain. Later, scientists from Tokyo took control over Titannus and ordered him to attack the U.S.A., believing that his rampage against Japan had been instigated by the Americans. Some superheroes- Doctor Strange, Spider-Man, Ms. Marvel, She-Hulk, Wolverine, Luke Cage, and Captain America- had to assemble to subdue him. Titannus was defeated and taken in by S.H.I.E.L.D., thanks to the new arrival of new hero Crusader, who distracted him by creating a fake reality where Titannus had killed all of his opponents, when Doctor Strange found the location of the people who controlled him and was able to use their technology to shut him down.

titano.name: Titano
titano.origin: Titano was a gigantic crustacean that terrorized various islands in the South Pacific and the North Atlantic. Legends from the islanders said that "When Titano rises from the deep, let the world beware!!" A special U.S. naval convoy was assigned with tracking down and destroying Titano by any means necessary. Commander Hartnell led Titano to the Arctic Circle where he managed to trap the monster by manipulating it between two giant glaciers.

tito bohusk.name: Tito Bohusk
tito bohusk.origin: Tito was born to the mutants Barnell Bohusk and Angel Salvadore, who met and copulated at the Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters. He had numerous siblings, two of whom were named Kara and Axel, and all of whom, except Tito, lost their mutant powers to the Decimation along with their parents. After the effects of Mothervine were spread around the world, his parents and siblings were repowered and reinstated as mutants again. When the mutant-only nation of Krakoa was established, he and his family became citizens after being attacked in their home and saved by the New Mutants.

titus.name: Titus
titus.origin: ===As a Supernova=== Titus was a member of the Supernovas, a branch of the Nova Corps. He served with Jesse Alexander, the father of Sam Alexander, Mister Z'zz, The Phlish, and a few other supernovas. Following the desertion of Jesse Alexander, Titus was attacked by the Chitauri, which lead to the loss of Titus' right eye and arm. After serving the Chitauri for several years, Titus came to Earth in search of Jesse Alexander's Nova helmet. ===With the Chitauri=== Titus lies to Sam telling him that he had killed his father however this is not true because Jesse Alexander is being held captive by the Chitauri. When Titus finds Sam he threatens not only him, but everything he holds dearly to him in exchange for the Ultimate Nullifier he stole from their ship. Sam then gets back his helmet from Titus and takes them both to outer space, expecting the lack of oxygen to kill Titus. When that plan fails Sam takes out the Ultimate Nullifier and tells Titus to take his forces and leave. Titus and Sam then struggle for the gun and Sam accidentally triggers it killing Titus and an entire fleet of Chitauri. ===Return=== Titus later turned up alive and partnered with Death's Head to ambush Sam and the recently resurrected Nova Prime while the pair was visiting Knowhere. He was defeated by Sam and Rider, however.

titus h crockett.name: Titus H. Crockett
titus h crockett.origin: Crooked business man Titus H. Crockett has dedicated his life to making as much money as possible, paying little mind to those he steps on to get it. One January morning, his secretary, Miss Raey, informs him that a man in the lobby is there to see Crockett about a "massive partnership" that will make tons of money. Crockett talks with the man, who refuses to give a name, about becoming partners. The man tells Crockett that before he shares his business plans, he must know if Crockett is scrupulous enough to be his partner. Crockett shares stories with the mystery man about his many dastardly deeds, including the time he swindled his own brother Carter out of his business, a move that drove Carter to suicide. Convinced, the businessman gives Crockett his business card and congratulates Crockett on becoming "one of his boys". Crockett is ecstatic about the partnership, but his excitement soon fades when he experiences a heart attack. As he breathes his last breath, Crockett looks at the business card and realizes he just made a deal with Satan.

titus locke.name: Titus Locke
titus locke.origin: Titus Locke was a resident of Freetown during the 1940s. He was the owner of the Freetown News, as well as its biggest employer and principal industry: the Tool Works. By the summer of 1942, he was deeply involved in war profiteering and labor crushing. This information came to pass the hands of Ella Wright who attempted to tip off newspaper reporter Jerry Dash of the rival paper the Star. To avoid this from getting out to the public, Titus had Ella murdered and framed Jerry for the killing. This prompted Jerry's friend Roddy Colt to learn the truth in his secret identity of the Secret Stamp. When the Secret Stamp managed to find proof that Jerry was not in town when the murder happened, Locke attempted to rally a lynch mob to hang Jerry instead. However, the Secret Stamp convinced the mob to let the law handle Jerry through a fair trial. When Titus attempted to get the mob going again, the Stamp accused him of the murder of Ella Wright and tackled him. Later, in a court of law, Jerry brought the full story to light with enough evidence to prove that Locke was responsible for Ella's murder. Locke's sentence and ultimate fate is unrecorded.

tityus.name: Tityus
tityus.origin: Tityus was the giant son of Zeus and the mortal Orchomenan princess Elara (though he has been described as a Titan on occasion). At a vengeful Hera's behest, Tityus attempted to rape Leto (daughter of the Titans Coeus and Phoebe), but was slain by Leto's twins Phoebus Apollo and Artemis and confied to Tartarus, where he remained among Zeus' most hated. There, vultures were to eat his immortal liver day after day, up to the modern era.

tiv scavenger.name: Tiv (Scavenger)
tiv scavenger.origin: Tiv and Biv were two scavengers living in the ruins of Titan. They confronted Thanos when he walked into what they claimed was their territory. Due to the villain's weakened state, neither Tiv nor Biv believed his claims of his identity, and proceeded to beat him up and steal his supplies. They were scared off by a flash of Champion's ship, and ran away. Later, when Thane came looking for his father, he learned from Biv and Tiv that the Mad Titan had left with Nebula, Champion, and Starfox. Thane then beheaded the scavengers before leaving.

tiwaz.name: Tiwaz
tiwaz.species: Elder God; Asgardian, first of the Aesir
tiwaz.origin: ===Origin=== Tiwaz was an Elder God embodying wisdom who emerged alongside other Elder Gods of Earth such as Gaea, Chthon, Set, Toranos, "Utgard-Loki", etc. when the Demiurge seeded the planet. When the Godwar broke out among the corrupted Elder Gods, Gaea birthed Atum to destroy them. Tiwaz (seemingly uncorrupted) faced and bested Atum using his wile and wit, and went his way wandering, and siring his own children . When he heard that "Utgard-Loki" and Toranos were going into exile together, he sent his servant Whiteface to inform Gaea. At some point, he ventured into Andlang but was frozen solid when he stood there for too long. The Norse cow Audumbla found him and licked him free, and he became known by another name: Buri. Buri was the first of the Aesir who were worshiped as gods by the ancient Viking and Germanic tribes of Northern Europe. In the myths and legends, Buri was the third entity to arise in creation, after the giant Ymir and the cow Audumbla. Intrigued, the Giants allowed Buri to live. Buri grew wise and strong and took a Frost Giantess as wife, and had three sons: Bor, Mimir and Njord. ===Succession=== He was succeeded by Bor after his son bested him in combat, and his other son Njord left to found Vanaheim and sire the Vanir. Bor in turn took a wife (the giantess Bestla) and fathered his sons. As Bor founded Asgard, home of the Aesir, Buri went to live recluse, returning to his original name Tiwaz, in the northern reaches of Asgard, in Nastrond, living among ephemeral servants he created by sculpting ice and animated with life. After Bor's death, Odin challenged and bested Buri as well. During the Aesir/Vanir War, Tiwaz witnessed from afar the death of Mimir (a peace hostage given by Odin), decapitated by the Vanir, and the eventual annexation of the Vanir to Asgard. He was eventually forgotten by the Asgardians. After Thor was born, Tiwaz visited him. ===Modern Age=== ====Nursing Thor==== thumb|right|Tiwaz and his bird, Whiteface (Earth-616)|Whiteface Tiwaz learned about Odin's death, and left footsteps for the grieving Thor to follow. He later discovered him after a brutal battle with Hela and took him and Mjolnir to his home. He nursed Thor back to health, wrestling with him in friendly matches to test him. Thor once believed him to be Odin, but Tiwaz proved him wrong. The sorcerer also refuted the story told by Odin's Eye about Odin's origin. He returned to normal strength and was able to beat Tiwaz. He then encouraged Thor to return to Asgard, and the Odinson departed Tiwaz's company, unaware that he was in fact Buri. He was directed to Frigga and the children who had went in hiding during Surtur's attack on Asgard. ====Helping the New Mutants==== Thor told Volstagg's children about Tiwaz, and they later fred Hrimhari, Boom Boom and Warlock from an Asgardian prison, sending them to recruit the aid of the Giant-sorcerer. They had nearly reached Tiwaz's dwelling, when they were caught in a net and captured by a Frost Giant serving Hela. They escaped from the Frost Giant's grasp, and Tiwaz appeared, imprisoning the Frost Giant in a block of ice. Tiwaz brought them into his cave, warmed them up and advised them on the true extent of Hela's threat and of her new sword, able to slay Odin and fell the World Tree. Tiwaz revealed the location of the Warriors Three and sent Hrimhari and the two New Mutants to free them from Queen Ula and her Savage Swarm of Hive Trolls. Tiwaz stayed behind and watched them. They managed to free the Warriors Three, though it required Tiwaz's magic to shrink Volstagg so that Warlock could fly him away. Later Tiwaz monitored from his home Karnilla's attempt to revive one of her stone-petrified men. She failed, but Tiwaz concentrated the excess magic from her spell to revive all people of Nornheim, still in their stone form. With Tiwaz' secret support, Hela's army was defeated and retreated to Hel. He later sent an ice-fairy to Asgard, transporting a vial using whose content transformed the people of Nornheim back into men of flesh and blood, and a map allowing the New Mutants to return to Midgard. ===Reuniting with Thor=== When Tyr became corrupted by a Skinner Box, Thor and his siblings went looking for him. He inadvertently found Tiwaz, who possessed the that could restore Tyr's soul. Tiwaz told Thor about his history as an Elder God and his identity as Buri. After answering a "riddle," Thor was given the rune and used it to fill the missing portion of Tyr's soul, thus removing Oblivion's influence. Afterwards, Tiwaz journeyed to Utgard to warn Utgard-Loki not to attack Andlang, as the ensuing war would have no winners. He met with Loki next to discuss their spell.

fields.notes: Tiwaz/Buri's true origin is an Elder God, but there are many alternative, mythological accounts to his origin: According to the legend, he was delivered from the ice by the magic cow licking it, the hair the first day, the head the second day, and Buri itself the third. Other accounts state he emerged from the ice by himself. Another legend states Audumbla licked his form from an ice block. He was also claimed to be Ymir's son by Doctor Strange. According to the book "A guide to Norse Religion," Buri was born at Ginnungagap the same way and alongside Ymir. It also claimed Buri produced Odin, Vili, and Ve without mention of Bor. Like how Toranos is the "Utgard-Thor" and "The-One-Who-Cannot-Be-Named" is the "Utgard-Loki," Tiwaz is the "Utgard-Odin."
fields.trivia: is a letter in the Runic alphabet, approximately equivalent to "T", and is connected with the god and therefore with victory and honor. In Marvel Comics, Buri is named Tiwaz; he and Tyr Odinson share the same rune. This was relevant when Tiwaz's rune restored Tyr's soul.
fields.species: Elder God; Asgardian, first of the Aesir
