toma zaslon.name: Toma Zaslon
toma zaslon.origin: Toma Zaslon was a general in the Russian Army. She opposed the mutant camps run by S.I.C.K.L.E. because she was secretly a mutant herself. General Zaslon was additionally directing the Titanium Man Mutant-Defense Project. Because she was the highest-ranking general opposing mutant camps, S.I.C.K.L.E. targeted her for assassination. They arranged the escape of Omega Red from the Stranniy Corrective Labor Camp and forced him to go after Zaslon since they had injected him with nanobots that could cause him pain. Weapon X attempted to stop Omega Red's escape, but the villain escaped with Sabretooth in tow. Sabretooth tried to convince Omega Red to fight off S.I.C.K.K.L.E.'s influence, but since he had no choice, he attacked Zaslon during a test of the Titanium Men. Omega Red expressed his regret and lack of choice in killing her, but Weapon X intervened before he could do so. Using her mutant powers, Zaslon raised a barrier of ice to keep her soldiers at bay in order to confront Omega Red without exposing her secret. Sabretooth stepped in and convinced General Zaslon and Omega Red to work together to take down S.I.C.K.L.E.. General Zaslon infiltrated the S.I.C.K.L.E. Mothercarrier and waited in one of the station's escape pods while Omega Red confronted Director Rossovich. When he attempted to escape, Rossovich stumbled into General Zaslon. After she revealed her nature as a mutant, she used a blast of ice to throw him out of the Mothercarrier and to his death. In the meantime, the Winter Guard had engaged Weapon X. Having appointed herself as the new director of S.I.C.K.L.E., General Zaslon declared the mutant foreigners to be friends of Russia and ordered the Winter Guard to stand down. Afterwards, she gifted Weapon X with a transport.

tomar.name: Tomar
tomar.origin: King Tomar was an Hyperborean warlord and an ambitious under-king. He was a long-time enemy of King Brian of Brythunia, and was known as a fierce fighter having sent countless warriors to their end. He married Kormlada, though he treated her harshly. Tomar entered into a border war with King Brian, to the south, possibly partially to give his war-god Borri the battles he needed to feed on, or else the god would perish. He sent Kormlada, with an offer to Malachi, the commander of the Brythunian Cavalry: In exchange for great riches, he would hold back his horsemen away from the battle. Malachi and Kormlada became lovers. Kormlada intended to slay Tomar once the Brythunians defeated, and set up Malachi as her puppet king. The two armies met at Ravenplain. Unlike King Brian who remained in his tent, Tomar led his troops on the battlefield against the Brythunians, in a savage battle opposing two armies of twenty thousand men. Conan participated to the battle, having joined the Brythunians after his escape from the Hyperborean prisons, and slew his jailer in the battle. Upon his newly-found friend Dunlang's death, Conan went berserk, involuntary rallying the Brythunians. Facing the loss of his kingdom and of his life, Tomar fled to the Brythunians' camp, intending to slay Brian in his tent. As the guards were distraught by their apparent victory, Tomar slipped into Brian's tent. The two finally simultaneously stabbed each other, and Conan arrived to witness their corpses.

tomas lara perez.name: Tomas Lara-Perez
tomas lara perez.origin: After discovering he had developed superpowers, Tomas Lara-Perez wanted to help people. However, he felt it was embarrassing to embrace the animal aspect of his powers, and decided to go instead with the alias of the Handsome Puncher. Once he enrolled at the Empire State University, he learned of Squirrel Girl. Inspired by the confidence she projected, Tomas decided to take a similar approach to fighting crime as her, taking up the alias of Chipmunk Hunk. At some point, Tomas also became the crime-fighting partner of Koi Boi. thumb|left|Tomas' civilian appearance Tomas first met Squirrel Girl's alter-ego, Doreen Green, on the first day of university, and she quickly developed a crush on him. Some days later, when Squirrel Girl was fighting Hippo at the campus bank, Chipmunk Hunk and Koi Boi intervened. After Doreen's roommate Nancy recognized Chipmunk Hunk, he revealed that he was actually Tomas. The heroes and Nancy then spent the night in a sleep over at Nancy and Doreen's room, during which Tomas and Doreen developed a friendship. Soon after, he began dating fellow student Mary Mahajan.

tomazooma manidoog.name: Tomazooma (Manidoog)
tomazooma manidoog.origin: Tomazooma is the god of kinship and storytelling of the Manidoog, the Native American gods. He came to be revered primarily by the Keewazi Tribe of Oklahoma. thumb|left|Tomazooma at the Council of Godheads When the Third Host of Celestials descended upon Earth in 1000 AD, both Tomazooma and Gitche Manitou attended a Council of Godheads meeting as representatives of the Manidoog to discuss the threat. In modern times, the Red Star Oil Company constructed a robot in the form of Tomazooma to scare the Keewazi Tribe into forfeiting their oil-rich territory in Oklahoma. Later, this same robot appeared in Carefree, Arizona, where it terrorized local workmen at an oil field. The Tomazooma robot was eventually destroyed following a brief battle with Nova. Captain America suggested that the Roxxon Energy Corporation had sent Tomazooma in order to scare locals into negotiating a land deal.

tombalo.name: Tombalo
tombalo.origin: Tombalo is an alien from the planet Uranos, a world unique to Earth-5106 a reality where space travel and exploration blossomed in the 1950s. He was an expert in "Electro Science" who went insane by the year 2000. He developed a weapon called an "Electro Arc" which erected a powerful force field in space that could disintegrate rocket ships. He then used the weapon to threaten the Galaxy council who in turn assigned Space Squadron field commander Jet Dixon to end his threat. With the aid of Space Squadron science officer LLA 38, Dixon created a device that would cause the Electro Arc to feed back on Tombalo. Tracking Tombalo down, Jet and LLA used the device on his ship causing enough feedback that killed Tombalo in the process, ending his threat.

tomi shishido.name: Tomi Shishido
tomi shishido.origin: ===Origin=== Born a mutant in Kyoto, Japan, Tomi Shishido was a gifted but disturbed child. He was 2 weeks old when he spoke his first sentence. He first walked at 3 months old and was literate by his first birthday. He had become a great painter by age 4, ranked among the top five artists in modern Japan, and composed his first opera and attempted suicide for the second time by his sixth birthday. At age 13, Tomi devised a mathematical formula that proved, without question, the existence of God and discovered what everyone else knew from the moment he was born. This last event seemed to deeply affect Shishido, who came to believe that, if God existed, then man could be nothing more than his slave, leading him to develop a great hatred to the sole concept of there even being a God. He became aware of his condition as a mutant with the ability of turning to stone just by looking at them and the Japanese media dubbed him the Gorgon. To cope with his deadly abilities, he learned how to fight and operate in daily life while blindfolded, in part thanks to low-level telepathic abilities. thumb|left|300px|The Kraken giving the Godkiller sword to the Gorgon At the same age, the Gorgon formed a mutant death-cult called the Dawn of the White Light and subjected Japan to relentless terrorist attacks over four years. Aspiring to darker and greater things than the Dawn, at age 18, he killed his family and his only real friend to get the attention of the ancient ninja clan known as the Hand and prove to them that he felt no fear. Soon after killing them, he was visited by the legendary Hydra agent known as the Kraken, in his apartment in Kobe, with his petrified family inside. He provided the young Gorgon with the sword known as Godkiller, an artifact that would grant him his destiny. Godkiller was one of two blades forged at the behest of Zeus and Amatsu-Mikaboshi when their respective pantheons of deities, the Olympians and the Amatsu-Kami, went to war. This gift gave the Gorgon the power to kill that which he hated more than anything else: gods. Aspiring to darker and greater things than the Dawn, the Gorgon found the Hand sanctuary in rural Japan and killed all of its guards while blindfolded to demonstrate his abilities. The Gorgon went inside and pledged his allegiance to the Hand's jōnin. When the master questioned his dedication, the Gorgon impaled himself with his own sword and begged to be resurrected with his dying breath. Impressed by his loyalty, the Hand brought the Gorgon back from death and he worked as one of their best warriors. Within one year, he became the High Priest of the Hand and ran the clan. Soon after, he forged an alliance with Hydra. thumb|right|250px|The Gorgon vs. James Howlett (Earth-616)|Wolverine ===Wolverine=== Falsely claiming he wished to prove himself against the warrior Wolverine, the Gorgon had the Hand kidnap the son of Ichiro Yashida, the cousin of Wolverine's dead fiancé, Mariko Yashida. Wolverine met the captors in Japan, only to find that it was a trap laid out for him. He obliterated all of the Hand warriors until only the Gorgon remained. Wolverine was incapacitated by being impaled through the chest by the Gorgon, who in turn announced that the boy had been already executed. With Hydra leader Baron Strucker's help, the Gorgon subjected Wolverine to brainwashing and released his debilitated body in South America in order to be recovered by S.H.I.E.L.D.. As an agent of Hydra, Wolverine ravaged a Helicarrier, being opposed by Elektra. He also managed to infiltrate and steal technological blue prints from Mister Fantastic in the Baxter Building so they could be weaponized by Hydra and destabilized the banking industry. Meanwhile, the Gorgon formed a sexual relationship with Elsbeth von Strucker, Baron Strucker's wife. As Wolverine approached his next target, Daredevil, the Gorgon led his forces to confront Elektra, who was revealed to be his actual target all along. The Gorgon succeeded during the fight, and Elektra was taken to the ceremonial altar for the brainwashing ritual. In order to assassinate the President of the United States, Hydra sent Wolverine against the Xavier Institute to use the telepathic machine Cerebra to execute the murder attempt. The mission was a failure, but led the X-Man Northstar to be slain and Wolverine to fall into S.H.I.E.L.D.'s custody. After his failure, Baron Strucker was eliminated by the Gorgon as part of his wife's plans; as a result, the Gorgon became the new Supreme Hydra. By having Hydra, the Hand and the Dawn of White Light under his command, the Gorgon assigned Elektra to lead an army of zombie super-human soldiers, including Northstar, to wage war against S.H.I.E.L.D. left|300px|thumb|The Gorgon's death Their first strike against S.H.I.E.L.D. was foiled by Wolverine, who had had his mind restored. In a new attempt to cause global terror, the Gorgon used Richards' studies to have A.I.M. design and build death machines for his cause of

tomi shishido clone.name: Tomi Shishido (Clone)
tomi shishido clone.origin: Following the rise and fall of Hydra in America, Arnim Zola turned his attention to Otto Octavius, whom he revamped into the Superior Octopus right before Hydra's rising. Zola ambushed the Octopus in the latter's hideout claiming the Octopus belonged to Hydra. One of Zola's agents during this ambush was a clone of the Gorgon created by Zola himself, similarly to a Life Model Decoy. Zola mentioned that his clone of the Gorgon did not have a personality by his own, being only a loyal Hydra goon with skills and intelligence far below than the original Gorgon. However, the clone was seemingly successful in turning Octavius into stone and killing him. Zola's plans turned awry after Octavius transferred his conscience to a cloned body and killed the Gorgon's clone.

tomik.name: Tomik
tomik.origin: Tomik was a young Chernayan man targeted by the military following General Petrov's coup for being gay. He was arrested from his home by soldiers so he could be taken into an internment camp for "re-education" purposes. The Punisher, while sporting a War Machine Armor, saved Tomik. He then directed the Punisher to one of the internment camp so he could take it down.

tommie boyd.name: Tommie Boyd
tommie boyd.origin: Tommie Boyd was a scrappy young girl who lived in the impoverished neighborhoods of Yancy Street in New York City. Her constant fighting earned her the nickname "Two-Fisted" Tommie Boyd. She later went on to lead an ethnically diverse incarnation of the Yancy Street Gang. When young drug addicts were going missing on Yancy Street, the gang grudgingly joined up with hated former member, the Fantastic Four's Thing to learn who was taking the addicts and why. Their investigation took them to an abandoned warehouse where they discovered the Fantastic Four's long time foe Dr. Doom was experimenting on the youths in order to develop a cure for drug addiction, however to date the experiments proved fatal. While the Thing battled Dr. Doom, the gang rescued his latest victim Jimmy Sokolowski, and they escaped just moments before Doom set the warehouse to explode. Later, the gang became prime suspects in the murder of young runaway Alison Gaulthing. The gang, having only witnessed the murder, were on the run from the authorities. When the Childwatch Organization hired the young hero named Justice to apprehend them. With the help of the Thing, Justice convinced the Yancy Street Gang to turn themselves in. Realizing that they were only witnesses to the murder, the gang was released from police custody. Later, the gang was involved in a brawl with the rival Nomads gang. The fight was later interrupted when a malfunctioning Doombot went on a rampage on Yancy Street, sending the Yancy Street and Nomad gangs fleeing. The Doombot was eventually taken down by the NYPD's Code: Blue division. Boyd and the members of her version of the Yancy Street Gang have not been seen since, their subsequent fate is unknown.

tommy morlock.name: Tommy (Morlock)
tommy morlock.origin: ===Early Life=== In her early years, Tommy's life was marked by a profound sense of alienation and solitude. Born with a unique mutant ability to contort her body, she possessed the remarkable power to become as thin as a piece of paper at will, before seamlessly returning to her normal form. However, this extraordinary gift proved to be a double-edged sword, drawing fear and rejection from those around her. ===Morlocks=== right|thumb She sought refuge among the underground outcasts, the Morlock lead by Callisto. As a Morlock, Tommy departed the confines of the Alley alongside companions, driven by a thirst for adventure in the world above. Their aspirations were swiftly thwarted by the relentless pursuit of the Marauders killed some of her Morlock friends which became known as the Mutant Massacre. She was rescued by the Hellfire Club mercenary Richard Salmons and brought to Los Angeles, where the Marauders tracked her down. left|thumb He intervened in Tommy's defense and amidst their escape from the Marauders at a train yard, Richard met his end, succumbing to a fatal hit of one of Harpoon's spears. Despite Richard's plea for her to help him, telling her that if they work together they have a chance to beat the Marauders, but if she runs they're both. But scared, Tommy chose to flee instead, leaving him to his demise as the Marauders closed in. Utilizing her remarkable ability to contort her form, Tommy evaded her pursuers by slipping into a narrow gap within a train car, journeying back eastward. Upon disembarking in Manhattan with intentions to retreat to the safety of the Alley, Tommy encountered Scalphunter lay in ambush, sealing her fate in killing her before she could escape. ===Posthumous appearances=== right|thumb During Scalphunter's rehabilitation, Danger, utilized a holographic projection featuring Tommy and the Morlocks within the Danger Room. In this simulation, Scalphunter was compelled to relive the tragic events of the Morlock Massacre. However, a surprising twist unfolded as the holographic representation of the deceased Tommy reassured Scalphunter that everything would be alright, presenting a scenario where forgiveness was possible, even for an assassin like himself Before Danger could witness the outcome of this unexpected turn, her attention was diverted by the arrival of Madison Jeffries, disrupting the unfolding scenario. When the assassin known as Cape Crow set his sights on Scalphunter, he delved into the man's history, uncovering a dark chapter that revealed Tommy as one of Scalphunter's unfortunate victims. ===Krakoa=== left|thumb Many years later, following the foundation of a mutant state in Krakoa by the hand of Charles Xavier and his allies, Tommy resurfaced as a citizen of the nation, having been reborn by the hand of the Five, a group of mutants capable of combining their powers into a process of resurrection, brought together by Xavier as part of his plans for mutant ascension. The Hellions, upon learning that Scalphunter, one of the Marauders responsible for the Mutant Massacre, was also residing on Krakoa, Tommy reunited with her resurrected Morlock comrades to confront the assassin on the solemn anniversary of the tragic event. However, their attempt at reconciliation was met with defiance, as Scalphunter displayed no remorse and brandished a formidable assault weapon. In response to the escalating tension, Callisto made the bold decision to dispatch Tommy and the others to eliminate Scalphunter, emphasizing that any casualties would be resurrected. Tommy and her companions engaged in the confrontation and met their demise, only to be resurrected shortly afterward. In a bid to address Scalphunter's transgressions, he was subsequently integrated into Mister Sinister's Hellions team, alongside other individuals deemed undesirable, as a form of punishment for his past actions. 300px|right|thumb During the Hellions' capture orchestrated by Arcade and Mastermind, Scalphunter found himself plunged into a harrowing scenario. In this simulation, he was confronted with a haunting memory of having taken innocent lives in a war zone. To his horror, the victims transformed into familiar faces from the Morlocks, including Tommy, Ape, Cybelle, Erg, Masque, and others, all seemingly lifeless. Yet, the nightmare took a terrifying turn when Tommy and Cybelle morphed into bloodthirsty zombies, driven by an insatiable hunger for flesh. In a shocking twist, they turned on Scalphunter, becoming his assailants in a horrifying ordeal within the fabricated reality. Tommy became an integral part of X-Force, joining them as a recon agent. When it came to light that Orchis had stationed an observation team in Paris to monitor a crucial gate utilized by Dr. Moira MacTaggert, X-Force devised a cunning plan. They installed another Krakoan gate at the same location but on a different floor, effectively misleading Orchis. Meanwhile, Tommy was assigned to another nearby building to surveil the Orchis t

tommy miller.name: Tommy Miller
tommy miller.origin: After going through a long illness, Tommy found a stray dog and brought it home saying that his name was Wish and he was a wishing dog. Initially against letting a stray into the house, they gave up when they saw that their son was better especially in the company of the dog. As some time passed, although his parents tried to dissuade Tommy from being convinced that Wish was a wishing dog, Tommy convinced his parents to ask for a wish, and they accepted even though they thought it was just Tommy's fantasy, so they both wished to "own" a million dollars. After a few days Wish left, just as Tommy had told his parents once he had made their wishes come true, and in fact he made diamonds worth a million dollars appear but which they couldn't resell anyway, because their wish said they owned it. At that point Tommy's parents asked him what he had asked for, and Tommy replied good health and friends, which had come true, making his parents very happy.

tommy murdock.name: Tommy Murdock
tommy murdock.origin: ===Early Life=== Thomas "Tommy" Murdock was an Irish immigrant who moved from Ireland to Hell's Kitchen, New York City, in the 1820s. He settled in a neighbourhood rife with gang warfare. In 1822, he joined the Roach Guards, a group of Irish immigrants formed to fight the anti-immigrant gang known as the Bowery Boys. Later, they created their own faction, the Dead Rabbits. Though a criminal, Tommy was a devout Catholic and regularly attended Mass at St. Matthew's Church. ===The Blind One=== On November 11th, 1835, he met with Father Emmett as he and his gang protected Irish churchgoers. However, the Bowery Boys arrived, confronting them in the streets. As the two groups prepared for battle, a Native American woman observed them from the shadows. Tommy soon learned that people in the area were being murdered, their bodies left with pieces of flesh missing. Seeking answers, he and his old gang encountered the Native American woman revealing her name to be Soena'hane'e. She revealed that the settlers had built their church on tainted land. Leading them to the church, she uncovered a hidden passageway descending into the earth. Deep below, Father Emmett stood before a pagan altar, revealing his true purpose. He had been waiting for Tommy, intending to sacrifice him to the demonic entity known as the Blind One. The priest and his followers had been sacrificing local Irishmen in an effort to summon the demon. Tommy fought back despite being stabbed, refusing to become their final offering. As the Blind One began to emerge into the earthly realm, Tommy seized the priest's knife and struck. Meanwhile, Soena’hane’e attacked the rising demon. In a final act of defiance, Tommy grabbed a rock and shattered the altar, killing the priest and sealing the demon’s passage. The tomb collapsed around him, and he perished, making the ultimate sacrifice. ===Matt Murdock=== For two centuries, Tommy's soul remained trapped in Purgatory. Eventually, he encountered his descendant, Matt Murdock, who had willingly sacrificed himself to stop the demon’s resurgence. Recognising their shared lineage, Tommy expressed his pride in Matt before they found themselves seated at a table with a mysterious fish-like figure. Before them lay seven cups, each representing a different path tied to Matt’s past, present, and future. Six promised a form of bliss, while the seventh, concealed beneath a cover, held either ultimate joy or unimaginable suffering. The only way forward was to make a choice. Matt selected the cup of sacrifice, and as he drank, the fish-like figure shed its disguise, revealing itself as the demonic Blind One. Snapping out of his trance, Tommy joined Matt in battle against the creature. In a final act of heroism, Tommy sacrificed himself once more, ensuring the demon's defeat and securing Matt’s return to the living world. With his purpose fulfilled, Tommy's soul finally found peace.

tommy ng.name: Tommy Ng
tommy ng.origin: Tommy "Scorch" Ng was a drug dealer working in Manhattan, making product for the Steel Waves gang. He was an early foe of the vigilantes Night Thrasher, Silhouette, and Midnight's Fire. Years later, Ng had gone legitimate with his own company, Bio-Dyne. Thrasher, as head of the Taylor Foundation, arranged to buy out Bio-Dyne to pursue its research in Sonovil, a mood stabilizer to help psychotics.

tommy pidgeon.name: Tommy Pidgeon
tommy pidgeon.origin: Tommy Pidgeon together with his friends wanted to prepare a welcome party for Tommy's Uncle Pete, since he had always been affable and helpful with the boys. Pete had been away on business for a long time, not knowing what kind of work Pete did anyway. Tommy's parents, however, did not agree to the party, telling the boys that Pete would be very tired when he returned and it was better to wait at least a few days. When the limousine that took Pete home arrived the boys were present and noticed that Pete was floating when he got out of the car, so they understood that Pete was an astronaut and had returned from Outer Space and therefore had to readjust to Earth's gravity. Seeing this, the boys and Tommy's parents still organized the welcome party using a trapeze that was in the barn where Pete could lean.

tommy roark.name: Tommy Roark
tommy roark.origin: Coming across a wanted poster offering a $5000 reward for his capture dead or alive, Ringo Kid just barely avoids getting his head blown off by a young boy with a rifle. Realizing he has missed his shot, the young lad is frightened by the Ringo Kid, but soon realizes that the famous outlaw is not as bad as the wanted posters make him out to be. Asking the young boy why he was after the reward on his head, the Ringo Kid learns that the lad -- named Tommy Roark -- comes from a poor family and his mother is deathly ill and they need the money for medicine. The Ringo Kid rides the boy home and they are shocked to find the Roark ranch on fire. The Ringo Kid rushes in and rescues Tommy's father and mother. After treating their wounds, the Ringo Kid learns that the fire was lit by a man named Baxter. The elder Roark explains to the Ringo Kid that Baxter loaned him money and mortgaged his property after his cattle was rustled and then after he purchased new cattle this herd was stolen as well. When Baxter came to collect his money, Roark refused to leave his home and that was when Baxter, finding the land more valuable than the house built on it, set the home ablaze. The Ringo Kid then decides to pay Baxter a visit and rides away unaware that his quarry and his gang have been secretly watching. Baxter tells his men that they are going to handle Roark and his family first then the Ringo Kid and collect the reward on his head. However the Ringo Kid is tipped off by his friend Dull Knife who happened upon Baxter and his men and heard the entire plot. The Ringo Kid then comes up with a plan and rides into town to talk to the local cattle buyer. There he learns that Baxter recently sold some cattle that resemble the ones that were stolen from Roark. The Ringo Kid then rides into town and confronts Baxter and his men in the local saloon and allows himself to be captured. He is quickly brought to trial and locked up with Baxter collecting the $5000 reward on the Kid's head. However, the Ringo Kid is not locked up for long as Dull Knife arrives outside his cell and cuts through the bars and helps the Kid escape. They then return to the saloon to confront Baxter and his men again. The Ringo Kid and Dull Knife easily disarm Baxter and his men and steal the reward money just as the sheriff arrives with evidence given to him by Dull Knife proving that Baxter stole, rebranded and sold cattle stole from Pete Roark. The Ringo Kid then returns to the Roark ranch and turns over the stolen reward money, telling the family they earned it before parting company.

fields.history: Coming across a wanted poster offering a $5000 reward for his capture dead or alive, Ringo Kid just barely avoids getting his head blown off by a young boy with a rifle. Realizing he has missed his shot, the young lad is frightened by the Ringo Kid, but soon realizes that the famous outlaw is not as bad as the wanted posters make him out to be. Asking the young boy why he was after the reward on his head, the Ringo Kid learns that the lad -- named Tommy Roark -- comes from a poor family and his mother is deathly ill and they need the money for medicine. The Ringo Kid rides the boy home and they are shocked to find the Roark ranch on fire. The Ringo Kid rushes in and rescues Tommy's father and mother. After treating their wounds, the Ringo Kid learns that the fire was lit by a man named Baxter. The elder Roark explains to the Ringo Kid that Baxter loaned him money and mortgaged his property after his cattle was rustled and then after he purchased new cattle this herd was stolen as well. When Baxter came to collect his money, Roark refused to leave his home and that was when Baxter, finding the land more valuable than the house built on it, set the home ablaze. The Ringo Kid then decides to pay Baxter a visit and rides away unaware that his quarry and his gang have been secretly watching. Baxter tells his men that they are going to handle Roark and his family first then the Ringo Kid and collect the reward on his head. However the Ringo Kid is tipped off by his friend Dull Knife who happened upon Baxter and his men and heard the entire plot. The Ringo Kid then comes up with a plan and rides into town to talk to the local cattle buyer. There he learns that Baxter recently sold some cattle that resemble the ones that were stolen from Roark. tommy thumb.name: Tommy Thumb
tommy thumb.origin: Tommy Thumb was a midget in Fritz Tiboldt's Circus in the 1940s. When the group was hired by the Nazi party to tour the United States and eliminate key military officials, he was forced to do Tiboldt's bidding through threats and intimidation. Fritz forced Tommy to release a tiger from its cage and set it to maul General Blaine of the U.S. Military. Spotted on the scene by Captain America and Bucky, they failed to capture him. However, Cap and Bucky later dismantled Fritz's operation. Tommy's subsequent fate remains unrevealed, however as Fritz Tibolt would return to Germany and resume his circus, it is possible that Tommy resumed working for Tibolt. As such, it is noteworthy to mention that Tibolt would later be murdered by Nazis who evaded capture in retribution of his failure, it is unknown if Tommy would have met the same fate.

tomo yoshida.name: Tomo Yoshida
tomo yoshida.origin: Tomo Yoshida had always suspected that his nephew Shiro, who would later be known as Sunfire, was a mutant. Tomo took him to irradiated ruins in Hiroshima, which triggered Shiro's mutant powers. He trained the young boy in the use of his powers, while at same time fanning hatred against the USA. He manipulated him into attacking targets in the USA while on a trip with his father Saburo Yoshida, who was a delegate to the United Nations. When Saburo tried to stop Sunfire from attacking the U.S. Congress, Tomo shot him from behind. Sunfire killed Tomo in retaliation.

tomoe.name: Tomoe
tomoe.species: Human with latent Inhuman lineageCategory:Human/Inhuman Hybrids activated by the Terrigen Cloud; Can temporarily exhibit cybernetic/technological enhancements
tomoe.origin: ===Origins=== Tomoe was a nobody who considered herself to have been reborn after being exposed to the Terrigen Mists spread throughout the world by the Terrigen Bomb. The mists activated her latent Inhuman genes, granting her the ability to control technology with nothing but thought. ===Crimelord=== Using her newfound abilities, Tomoe drove away the different nefarious organizations that preyed on her land, amassing an army of "biohack" ninja in the process, made up of other people she considered to be "disowned and disenfranchised," and successfully seized control of the underworld in Osaka, Japan as the head of the Southeast Asia Crime Syndicate. During her journey to retrieve powerful mystical objects, Madame Masque crossed paths with Tomoe's ninja clan, and made enemies of them. Iron Man first came into contact with the clan when he came across several ninja while investigating Masque's operations, and they tried to murder him to remain in the shadows. thumb|left|Tomoe's Techno Golem Armor After Masque's defeat, Tony Stark enlisted the help of his friend War Machine to find out why were they trailing her. During the investigation, he was abducted by two of them and taken to a warehouse, where he encountered Tomoe. Tomoe used her abilities to strip Rhodes of his armor and don it herself, making it bulkier by additionally using other components from the warehouse. Before she could interrogate and kill Rhodes, Iron Man and Spider-Man appeared on the scene to rescue him; however, she absorbed Stark's armor into her as well, gaining even more power and creating a devastating explosion that seemingly killed Stark. Stark actually survived, but went under the radar and adopted the identity of "Richard Franco," an alleged former Navy SEAL and ex-S.H.I.E.L.D. agent. Under the alias of Franco, Stark made his way through the Japanese underground for weeks until Tomoe took notice of him and enlisted his help in finding War Machine and killing him in order to tie up loose ends. When Rhodes decided to put an end to Tony's undercover operation for his own good, he enlisted the help of the Avengers. The growing presence of superheroes in Osaka worried Tomoe, thinking they had arrived to avenge Tony Stark. The heroes eventually attacked Tomoe's base of operations, disrupting her enterprise; however, Tomoe herself had preemptively escaped. Tomoe eventually reorganized her criminal empire. Having caught notice of Ironheart having taken up the legacy of Tony Stark when he fell into a coma following the second superhuman civil war, she decided to take her down to prevent her operations from being disturbed again. Tomoe proceeded to attack Ironheart and Rescue in Chicago, backed up by an army of ninja and having stripped the heroines of her suits to encase herself in a new armor. Riri managed to slip away to get help while Pepper Potts fended off Tomoe's ninja and tried to stall for time. When Tomoe grew tired of Pepper's shenanigans, she prepared to execute her. The Techno Golem was interrupted by the apparent return of Tony Stark, sporting an Iron Man armor. Tomoe absorbed the suit, only to discover that was nobody inside, and that who confronted her was a digital duplicate of Stark's mind. When Tomoe took control of the armor, the Stark A.I. uploaded a virus into her systems which disrupted her powers, knocking out her ninja in the process. Tomoe emerged from the rubble of her disarmed armor and tried to kill Riri with a sword, she was, however, knocked unconscious by Rescue's remotely-controlled gauntlet. When S.H.I.E.L.D. arrived to the scene shortly afterwards, they apprehended Tomoe. Tomoe later appeared to have escaped custody, and continued operating in the Japanese underworld. She came across Miles Morales, Spider-Man's alter-ego, in Tokyo and arranged a meet-up with him after being impressed by his display of power against Goblin Nation thugs.

tomas aguado.name: Tomás Aguado
tomas aguado.origin: Tomás Aguado, alias Striker, was an international mercenary with superhuman powers. He was recruited to participate in the civil war in San Revilla, a Central American country, through the Advisor, a mysterious person who could have demonic powers, and who intended to motivate San Revilla until it completely self-destructed, apparently with the purpose of defining a way to destroy a country that could be replicated elsewhere, for which he operated with both sides of the war. The Advisor considered it essential to use superhumans in this conflict, so to start he made the anti-government rebel group the Shadows, considered insurgents and terrorists, have an elite parahuman unit that included Striker and another mercenary, Sundance. The Shadows were a ruthless group that operated stealthily, attacking troops and refugees without warning to vanish thanks to Sundance's powers of light amplification. Most rebel soldiers were equipped with standardized high-tech weapons and armor. The Advisor also recruited former Avenger Hawkeye to lead and train the Shadows, tricking him into believing that the U.S. State Department was backing the rebel faction against the fascist government militia. Hawkeye took the job, ensuring that he planned operations to hit resources, not people, and avoiding even killing soldiers. However, unbeknownst to Hawkeye, the Shadows were attacking not only government troops but even civilians with lethal force. The Shadows' escalating attacks, organized from a jungle hideway near Vitidos, and the brutal responses of the government military (also equipped with advanced technology thanks to the Advisor) left field hospitals overflowing and without available resources in dilapidated buildings on the edges of the war zone. The Advisor also recruited superhumans to operate for the government, including Hazzerd and Troubleshooter, two superhuman mercenaries, and the U.S.Agent, another Avenger who believed he was working for the US Commission on Superhuman Affairs to confront rogue terrorists. Meanwhile, photojournalist Luke Bergier traveled to San Revilla with his fiancée Cindy to cover the war, but they had to try to leave the country on a Red Cross flight. While on the government airstrip, the Shadows attacked refugees and troops; Hawkeye was present but apparently this part of the operation was hidden from him. Striker threw Luke and Cindy into a hangar wall, breaking his arm and her neck. Luke was sent to a dilapidated field hospital. Luke's sister, Rebecca Bergier, worked as head of operations for the NGO Worldwatch, investigating human rights causes, and convinced her coworker James Rhodes (secretly the superhero War Machine) to go to San Revilla to help Luke. With access to confidential data from San Revilla and technology to monitor radio traffic in the area, War Machine infiltrated San Revilla and met with Luke. Rhodes recommended that Luke leave the country as soon as possible on a refugee flight, and Luke gave Rhodes his camera to develop the images. One of the photos Rhodes saw appeared to show Hawkeye. Meanwhile, Hawkeye led the Shadows to attack a government fuel dump in Vitidos, causing a raging fire; Rhodes eavesdropped the government's warning and went there in his War Machine armor to try to stop the rebels before they harmed anyone else. Initially successful against non-powered troops, whom he stunned with a low-intensity repulsor thump, War Machine was then stunned when Striker and Sundance sneaked up and punched him with super-strength force. War Machine deduced the nature of his enemies' powers as they pummeled him, and then ran into Hawkeye, who sided with Sundance. Striker then threw War Machine into oil drums, and Hawkeye started a fire to escape. However, by then, War Machine was able to reconfigure his sensors and track the Shadows, having deduced how they concealed themselves. War Machine arrived at the Shadows' secret camp and spoke with Hawkeye, but neither could convince the other, and War Machine retreated. Shortly after, the Shadows received orders to attack the Preto airstrip, supposedly because it was used to "ship in foreign mercenaries for the government." War Machine intercepted the communication and, using his armor's telescopic vision, confirmed that the airstrip had only three planes for refugee flights out of the country; he also saw Luke Bergier there. War Machine also discovered that the Advisor was manipulating the situation, so he went to Preto, where Hawkeye and his Shadows attacked planes and resources at Hawkeye's insistence. But before War Machine could get control of the situation, the government's superhuman agents: Hazzerd, Troubleshooter, and U.S.Agent, arrived with support troops. The mere presence of Hawkeye and War Machine made U.S.Agent reconsider, unwilling to confront people he trusted, but Hazzerd attacked Hawkeye to fulfill his contract, starting a fight especially since the Shadows were ready. However, unbeknownst to Hawkeye, the Shadows were attacking not only government troops but even civilians with lethal force. The Shadows' escalating attacks, organized from a jungle hideway near Vitidos, and the brutal responses of the government military (also equipped with advanced technology thanks to the Advisor) left field hospitals overflowing and without available resources in dilapidated buildings on the edges of the war zone. The Advisor also recruited superhumans to operate for the government, including Hazzerd and Troubleshooter, two superhuman mercenaries, and the U.S.Agent, another Avenger who believed he was working for the US Commission on Superhuman Affairs to confront rogue terrorists. Meanwhile, photojournalist Luke Bergier traveled to San Revilla with his fiancée Cindy to cover the war, but they had to try to leave the country on a Red Cross flight. While on the government airstrip, the Shadows attacked refugees and troops; Hawkeye was present but apparently this part of the operation was hidden from him. Striker threw Luke and Cindy into a hangar wall, breaking his arm and her neck. Luke was sent to a dilapidated field hospital. Luke's sister, Rebecca Bergier, worked as head of operations for the NGO Worldwatch, investigating human rights causes, and convinced her coworker James Rhodes (secretly the superhero War Machine) to go to San Revilla to help Luke. With access to confidential data from San Revilla and technology to monitor radio traffic in the area, War Machine infiltrated San Revilla and met with Luke. Rhodes recommended that Luke leave the country as soon as possible on a refugee flight, and Luke gave Rhodes his camera to develop the images. One of the photos Rhodes saw appeared to show Hawkeye. Meanwhile, Hawkeye led the Shadows to attack a government fuel dump in Vitidos, causing a raging fire; Rhodes eavesdropped the government's warning and went there in his War Machine armor to try to stop the rebels before they harmed anyone else. Initially successful against non-powered troops, whom he stunned with a low-intensity repulsor thump, War Machine was then stunned when Striker and Sundance sneaked up and punched him with super-strength force. War Machine deduced the nature of his enemies' powers as they pummeled him, and then ran into Hawkeye, who sided with Sundance. Striker then threw War Machine into oil drums, and Hawkeye started a fire to escape. However, by then, War Machine was able to reconfigure his sensors and track the Shadows, having deduced how they concealed themselves. War Machine arrived at the Shadows' secret camp and spoke with Hawkeye, but neither could convince the other, and War Machine retreated. Shortly after, the Shadows received orders to attack the Preto airstrip, supposedly because it was used to "ship in foreign mercenaries for the government." War Machine intercepted the communication and, using his armor's telescopic vision, confirmed that the airstrip had only three planes for refugee flights out of the country; he also saw Luke Bergier there. War Machine also discovered that the Advisor was manipulating the situation, so he went to Preto, where Hawkeye and his Shadows attacked planes and resources at Hawkeye's insistence. But before War Machine could get control of the situation, the government's superhuman agents: Hazzerd, Troubleshooter, and U.S.Agent, arrived with support troops. The mere presence of Hawkeye and War Machine made U.S.Agent reconsider, unwilling to confront people he trusted, but Hazzerd attacked Hawkeye to fulfill his contract, starting a fight especially since the Shadows were ready. tonaja.name: Tonaja
tonaja.origin: Tonaja was a young Inhuman, part of a class prior to exposure to Terrigen Mist, which included Nahrees, Dinu (who Tonaja liked), Woz and Kalikya, her best friend. Tonaja was very afraid of changing in the mists, and confided in her grandmother. After Terrigenesis, though, she became the first Inhuman flier evolved naturally in 30-years. Tonaja chose the alias Archaeopteryx, like the prehistoric bird and, along with Dinu and Nahrees entered in the Royal Guard. Gorgon repeatedly insulted them and assigned ridiculous tasks, such as taking care of Lockjaw. When the army led by Yuri Stalyenko attacked Attilan according to a plan that Maximus devised, and which king Black Bolt already knew beforehand but sought to use in their favor, Tonaja and her companions were assigned to the front line of battle, where she was reunited with her other friends and Kalikya, discovering that she had healing powers. Tonaja tried to ask forgiveness for what she had said after their mutation but this time she was rejected, realizing she had been cruel to her friend. Tonaja and her companions fought until Black Bolt ordered the withdrawal. Tonaja was later chosen among a group of Inhuman exchange students to visit and study on Earth.

tongah.name: Tongah
tongah.origin: Tongah was the tribal leader of the Fall People and long-time friend and ally to Ka-Zar. He married Seesha, unaware that she and Ka-Zar had had an affair in the past. He was befallen by a madness possibly caused by the proximity of Vibranium while out hunting with Ka-Zar, which caused Ka-Zar to travel to London to find a scientist who could help combat the illness. During Ka-Zar's absence, Tongah discovered that the Savage Land was being invaded by the Sheenarians. Tongah attacked and killed their commander, for which they demanded Tongah's life. Tongah accompanied Ka-Zar to the Sheenarians' home dimension to prevent further invasions. There, he was captured by the Kramen who syphoned off his life energy, rapidly aging him. Tonga helped Ka-Zar evacuate the Fall People. He then listened the tale of the legendary Chtylok, as told by Mathala.

tongue inhuman.origin: Tongue is an Inhuman student chef and Friends of the Tower. There Ulysses Cain met her when Karnak introduced her to his visit to the Tower. Tongue detected in the boy fear and disgust, so she asked Karnak to remove it from her sight. Later, when Ulysses escaped from his cell after Karnak left him imprisoned in it, Tongue found him trying to escape from the Tower, so he advised him to go back. As Ulysses failed to persuade Tongue to let him in, he tried to escape from her. Tongue went after him and cornered him in the kitchen, so the boy grabbed a bowl full of chilies and threw them into her face saturating the sense of the taste of the cook and thus escaping. . Later, Karnak asked Ulysses to apologize to Tongue.

toni harris.name: Toni Harris
toni harris.origin: Toni Harris was a student who got an internship to the Daily Bugle. J. Jonah Jameson remarked that "I am not paying these kids to surf the Internet!" when he saw her looking at a webpage annoucing a music video by Zane Whelan. Peter Parker said since she and Sam Exmore are interns, the Bugle is allowing them to work for free; and convinced Jameson to approve Harris and Exmore to do a story on the forthcoming music video. Toni was not a drug user, and cautioned Sam about the dangers of marijuana. She also noticed the props used on the set of the music video, such as a harness used to break Zane's fall when he jumped off a ledge while supposedly high.

toni ho.name: Toni Ho
toni ho.origin: ===Early life=== Toni Ho's mother moved from China to Seattle in the '70s. A decade later, she fell in love with and married brilliant medical researcher Ho Yinsen, with whom she had Toni. Their marriage eventually fell apart, causing Yinsen to move back to Timbetpal. He kept in touch with Toni regardless, through letters, phone calls, and occasional visits. When Toni was eleven years old, Yinsen died saving Tony Stark's life in Siancong. Because of this, Toni resented Stark, believing he should've done more to save her father. From then on, Toni set out to be better than him. After the unpleasant experience of high school, Toni began to study programming and engineering. Her talent got her a scholarship to Caltech, where she overlapped studies and eventually got three doctorates. She joined A.I.M. when Bobby Da Costa rebranded it Avengers Idea Mechanics, and began to work for its Engineering Division. ===New Avenger=== Toni took particular interest on studying the nature of Aikku Jokinen, a member of A.I.M.'s New Avengers whose body was merged with an intelligent suit of armor named Pod. Her interest only increased upon merging minds with Aikku in Avenger Five while the New Avengers fought American Kaiju, where she saw Aikku's real face. Toni began to admire Aikku for the sacrifice that meant giving up on a normal life to remain merged with the armor solely to ensure Pod's systems wouldn't reset, which would be the equivalent of killing it. The villainous Maker invaded A.I.M.'s Avenger Base Two when Toni was studying Pod at the base's Engineering Bay, and attacked them, seemingly killing Pod in the process. thumb|left|As Rescue Toni survived using a personal force shield, and subsequently donned her own Rescue Armor to fend off the intruders. When she began to assess the damage suffered by Pod, Aikku emerged from its carcass wearing the armor's undersuit, torn by grief because the magnitude of the attack had prevented Pod from ensuring the survival of both Aikku and itself. Toni helped Aikku get used to the power set of Pod's undersuit. After a mission shutting down the rogue A.I.M. splinter cell A.G.M., Aikku expressed her gratitude for Toni's support in coping with Pod's absence, and both shared a kiss after confessing their feelings for each other. ===U.S.Avenger=== When A.I.M. became a branch of S.H.I.E.L.D. under the name of American Intelligence Mechanics, Toni joined the organization's U.S.Avengers, undergoing a rebranding herself. Having ditched the Rescue Armor, Toni became the new Iron Patriot, but with the non-lethal aspect of her previous suit integrated into her new armor. Unfortunately, Toni's new research started to consume her. She would rarely sleep and only eat when Aikku insisted. Additionally, the weaponry Toni created for her suits blurred the line between non-lethal and lethal despite her insistence they weren't meant to hurt people. Toni eventually heeded Aikku's concerns, and decided to ditch making suits or even wearing one. thumb|right|As Iron Patriot Following the temporary takeover of the government by Hydra's hand, with the dissolution of S.H.I.E.L.D. being one of many casualties, the new Presidential administration attempted to fully take control of A.I.M. Roberto managed to save A.I.M. from this change of order by resigning as the Supreme Leader. The position of Supreme Leader was taken to a vote, and Toni won. Shortly afterward, the U.S.Avengers joined forces with the other Avengers teams as a consequence of a cosmic contest played by the Grandmaster and the Challenger. Following the conflict's end, Roberto disbanded the U.S.Avengers, and Toni decided to tackle the remaining rogue A.I.M. cells by rebranding their own as R.E.S.C.U.E. Some time later, she joined the Daughters of Liberty as a computer expert under the codename of "Hekate-4."

Unfortunately, Toni's new research started to consume her. She would rarely sleep and only eat when Aikku insisted. Additionally, the weaponry Toni created for her suits blurred the line between non-lethal and lethal despite her insistence they weren't meant to hurt people. He kept in touch with Toni regardless, through letters, phone calls, and occasional visits. When Toni was eleven years old, Yinsen died saving Tony Stark's life in Siancong. Because of this, Toni resented Stark, believing he should've done more to save her father. From then on, Toni set out to be better than him. tony casino.origin: Tony was the brother of mob boss Tommy Casino, who had been killed by the Punisher, Tommy tormented his brother for being a little person throughout their lives despite Tony trying to get him to understand that on the inside he was just like him. After his brother's death alongside many other high-level mob bosses, Tony gathered a gang of other disenfranchised and abused little people and began capturing other mobsters and amputating their legs with the ultimate goal of taking over all organised crime in New York City and having the amputees serve them as slaves. He and his gang were killed by the Punisher and Wolverine, Tony was killed while he was trying to escape down a tunnel, after getting his legs sliced off by Wolverine, when the Punisher dropped a grenade down the shaft, vaporizing him.

tony consiglio.name: Tony Consiglio
tony consiglio.origin: Tony Consiglio was a member of Black Cat's Gang. He recommended his friend Lee Price to Mac Gargan for a transactional job with Tombstone's Gang. The transaction went awry when Tombstone's men refused to turn in payment, and Tony pointed his gun at them. Before they could exchange gunfire, the Venom symbiote arrived at the scene and bonded to Lee. Now transformed into Venom, Lee slaughtered both Tombstone's men and the employees of Black Cat that were accompanying him and Tony. When Lee calmed down, Tony initially suggested taking him to a hospital to be checked out. Upon finding out that Lee's new "suit" was powerful enough to take on heroes like Spider-Man, Tony wondered what their next course of action would be. Having realized the potential of having the symbiote if it was kept a secret, Lee killed Tony.

tony conville.name: Tony Conville
tony conville.origin: Tony Conville worked for a fashion show, who in the summer of 1942 let his greed get the better of him. He got involved with racketeer Big Sutton and came up with an insurance fraud scheme involving the jewels that were going to be put on display for a fashion show. The jewels were to be stolen so that the insurance could be cashed in and split between Conville and Sutton. To this end, Conville hired Boots Connors to replace the model that was to wear the jewels to aid in the theft. However, Boots attempted to blackmail Conville by threatening to expose him with the letters he had written to her about the plan. In order to protect himself, Conville murdered Boots and her roommate and destroyed the damning evidence. This however, did not prevent comic book writer Red Skeleton from trying to solve the case. Conville had Red captured and brought him to Big Sutton to be eliminated. Angry that Conville murdered two women, thus complicating their scheme by getting the authorities even more involved than ever, Sutton decided to eliminate Conville as well. Conville's life was spared thanks to the timely arrival of Skeleton's friend, photographer Deena Drayson. Drayson distracted the mobsters long enough for Red to knock them out. Conville was turned over to the authorities, his fate is unknown.

tony diaz.origin: Tony Diaz was one of the first responders to the Chitauri incident that occurred in New York City. As a souvenir, his fire department kept a Chitauri helmet. Months later, Diaz and some of his friends decided to clean the helmet. Unwillingly, they brushed off a Chitauri bacteria that infected Diaz (and two others), causing him to be able to levitate objects and emit static electricity. Eventually, as Agent Phil Coulson tried to calm him down, Diaz disappeared in a flash of electricity.

tony paretti.name: Tony Paretti
tony paretti.origin: Tony Paretti was a fellow student of Robert Farrell at the Empire State University. While Robert was going to the university as Rocket Racer because he was late, he came across a scene where Tony was being threatened to be killed by a drug dealer because he had decided to stop dealing the drug Ice for him. Rocket Racer rescued Tony and roughed up the drug dealer by threatening him if he only dared to hurt Tony. When Tony thanked Rocket Racer for the rescue, he told him not to because if he caught him just talking to the drug dealer he would do to him what he threatened to do to the drug dealer.

tony scarlatti.name: Tony Scarlatti
tony scarlatti.origin: Reportedly a big-time racketeer, Tony Scarlatti got where he was by betraying Nick Pinto, resulting in Pinto being sentenced to death. After his execution, however, Pinto showed up alive at Scarlatti’s office, frightening his former henchman before fatally shooting him. Left to die, Scarlatti made a telephone call to police headquarters, telling the answering desk sergeant who had killed him before expiring.

tony stark 2 0.name: Tony Stark 2.0
tony stark 2 0.origin: Tony Stark 2.0 was the result of the activation of a contingency plan equipped into the Iron Man Armor Model 28 shortly after its creation. If its user was rendered incapacitated or killed while wearing it, the armor would be forced to attempt an emergency upload of their consciousness. The armor's processors had created a beta model of Stark's personality, "Tony Stark 2.0." As he was about to test it, Tony Stark was attacked by a group of mechas known as Beautiful Garbage. Using a rail gun, the armor was pierced and Iron Man was severely injured. While the armor protected an unconscious Stark by activating the combat autopilot option, the emergency uploading protocols were met, and the armor's set of neurofunction scans were merged with the pre-existing Tony Stark 2.0 persona model, working with 79% cognitive integrity. After escaping the mechas, the system control of the armor was transferred to Tony Stark 2.0, who proceeded to remove the real Stark and place him in the wooded area adjacent to Stark Industries, so he could be found by S.H.I.E.L.D. operatives soon in the scene. However, Beautiful Garbage operative Absynthe doctored the fooage of the inciden and sent it to S.H.I.E.L.D., framing Tony 2.0 for the attack on Stark Industries and Stark's severe injury, leading the spy organization to start a hunt for Iron Man 2.0. S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Capekiller unit led by Major Tom Aramaki tried to destroy Iron Man 2.0 in an aerial pursuit, but they failed. During the pursuit, and soon after going under the radar and ditching one of S.H.I.E.L.D.'s "Gungir" missiles, Iron Man 2.0 began to see hallucinatory images of a tattooed and pierced woman, who showed the intention of erasing "Tony Stark 2.0" from the armor's systems. To avoid S.H.I.E.L.D.'s attention, Iron Man 2.0 kept going in a "borrowed" car (seemingly of Johnny Storm's propriety). While on the car, Tony 2.0 analysed the entry hole drilled through the edge of the suit's right hand with the rail gun, and discovered said rail gun had been developed by Mecha Underground. Tony 2.0 set out to one of Mecha Underground's underwater parties in order to gather intel and find out who had attacked "Tony 1.0." However, the armor's right hand repulsor suddenly activated, damaging the car and precipitating it and Tony 2.0 to water. Absynthe, a virtual avatar of a virus which was the cause of the error showed herself in Tony 2.0's virtual reality systems. Absynthe stated that she had been uploaded into the armor via deposit by the rail gun round that penetrated it, and was slowly writing herself over the armor's operating code. The avatar soon disappeared, and Iron Man 2.0 continued with his plan of infiltrating the underwater Mecha Underground party, using the armor's camouflage to look like a regular robot. Before he could interrogate the mecha identified as the builder of the rail gun, Iron Man 2.0's cover was blown by Absynthe, who used the armor's disguise display to reveal Tony 2.0's identity. Abysnthe also proceeded to hack the other mechas at the party, and attack him. A S.H.I.E.L.D. Undercover Mech-Intel Operative identified Iron Man, and informed the Capekiller unit of his location. Iron Man 2.0 defeated the Mecha Underground and exfiltrated to the surface, not before having microdrones adhered to his armor's surface by the S.H.I.E.L.D. Mech, which lit him up in S.H.I.E.L.D.'s radar, and projected an ideal target profile to S.H.I.E.L.D.. As he was flying away, the operating systems of Tony 2.0's armor was cracked by Absynthe, who opened up the suit. Absynthe had also cracked Tony 2.0's personality construct and started overwriting his memories and programming code. With Tony 2.0 unable to pilot the suit, it entered in tactical autopilot mode when facing S.H.I.E.L.D.'s firepower. After finally being seemingly deleted by Absynthe, Tony 2.0 revealed that while Absynthe overwrote his memory space, he had simultaneously overwritten himself into her memory space. With access to Absynthe's memories, Tony 2.0 discovered her origin. After gaining control over his armor, Absynthe revealed there were other parts her plan. A group of mechas, the Beautiful Garbage, attacked the Assault Carrier of the Capekillers. Even though he managed to destroy one of the mechs, Iron Man 2.0 had to jack up his cognitive clockspeed to match and surpass that of the mechs. However, the Absynthe downloaded Stark 2.0's accelerationware into the Beautiful Garbage, which run better on their processors. Similarly to the way in which Absynthe had hacked the Mech Underground, Tony wrote additional functions into the accelerationware stolen from him, which turned the remaining Beautiful Garbage into software-parasitized puppets. Tony 2.0 made the mechs destroy each other. During the attack on the carrier, a contingency plan was activated, which consisted in the detonation of a 1.5 megaton thermonuclear warhead. With only 7 seconds left for the detonation, Tony 2.0 managed to crack the carrier's tactic

fields.trivia: Tony Stark 2.0's top 5 positives about not having an organic human body are: The ability to listen to music at volumes ear-damaging for human bodies. No brain damage and concussions caused by combat. No aging. The inability to ingest fluids, like alcohol, making it impossible for him to fall off the wagon. (Even though he has considered developing a software which could virtually emulate the effects of alcohol) The lack of any bodily fluids, such as sweat, mucus, pus, phlegm, urine and vomit.

tony tipple.name: Tony Tipple
tony tipple.origin: Tony Tipple wanted to have a parakeet, like many of his friends but couldn't afford it. After seeing the evolutions of his friend Toodles Murphy's parakeet, he went home sad but on the way he met a garishly dressed man. Asking him who he was and what he did, the man replied that he was taking a bird census but that of the earphones he used to listen to the birds, one had fallen off and he couldn't find it and the other wasn't working well. After chatting with Tony and giving him some information about birds, the strange man left and soon after Tony found the earpiece that the man had lost. By wearing it he discovered that he really could listen to the birds and understand them to the point of being able to make pigeons listen to him, becoming the envy of the other inhabitants of the town. Thanks to this, Tony became a true expert and scholar of ornithology without anyone knowing that he could really talk to birds.

tony trainer.name: Tony Trainer
tony trainer.origin: Despite the objections of Dr. Marla Madison, Tony Trainer was ordered by Morelle Pharmaceuticals rep Marcus Devane to begin the microwave bombardment of bio-samples from Quicksand and the Sandman as part of Project: Sandstorm. Trainer, more concerned with the excitement of pure science than their bickering, did as he was told. The two microwave-irradiated samples gained contact with each other and created a dual magnetic resonance, resulting in a massive explosion. Encased in an amorphous shell of particles, Trainer ground his way across the Empire State University campus, adding to his mass as he pulverized everything in his path. Spider-Man rescued Dr. Madison from his path of destruction and dropped a wall on him, briefly halting his rampage. As Quicksand and Sandman arrived at the trail of their purloined bio-samples, Trainer emerged in his new humanoid form as Sandstorm. Believing that he'd killed Devane, who had actually been killed in the explosion, Sandstorm generated a massive sand-maelstrom while Spider-Man and Sandman escaped to safety. He briefly battled Quicksand until she claimed that she'd come to help him. Together, they battled Spider-Man and Sandman. Sandstorm disabled Sandman with his sand-spikes, but was rendered powerless when Spider-Man hit him with a chunk of reverse-polarized shrapnel which dispersed his fused-grit armor. As the police took Trainer away, Sandman stayed with him to ensure that he was treated fairly.

tony trent.name: Tony Trent
tony trent.origin: Tony Trent was a bank robber and murderer who, after making a quarter-million dollar heist, was captured and sentenced to death, but not before hiding the loot. However, he managed to escape from death row and during his escape he stumbled upon a shack inhabited by a hermit but who recognized Trent. Agreeing to reveal where the loot was if he helped him in his escape, as soon as he had written the hiding place on a piece of paper Trent was immediately killed by the hermit but on his deathbed Trent cursed him telling him that his face would haunt him until his death. In fact the hermit was killed by the police when he was recovering the loot and his face had become that of Trent.

tooby.name: Tooby
tooby.origin: Tooby was a member of the amphibian race of the Tubanti and was close friends with Matty Plunder, the son of Ka-Zar and Zahmis of the tailed Tree People. These three would regularly play in the jungles of the Savage Land. While they were playing, Zahmis tells her friends that someone had burned the forest, and their friend Rucha replied that her mom had told her that whoever did would plant more trees and produce food, even though her friends didn't believe her and when Tooby asked her where the food was coming from, she replied that his mom had told him it was complicated to explain. The tribe had to abandon their waters due to the oil pollution caused by the Roxxon "Pangean Horizon" oil rig accident. While the tribe tried to be hosted by some other tribe, Tooby happily continued to play with Matthew. Tooby was among the victims of antibiotics supplied by Roxxon of which he was among many of his tribe to be allergic to that drug.

tooloo.name: Tooloo
tooloo.origin: Toloo appeared as a short, broad-shouldered man wearing outdated beach clothing, a derby hat, and an oversized tie. He first manifested before Jimmy Binn during the latter’s vacation at a seaside boardwalk, seemingly aware of Jimmy’s private thoughts and insecurities. Though physically unimpressive, Toloo demonstrated extraordinary strength and agility, effortlessly overpowering a group of powerful acrobats who had been bullying beachgoers. His abilities appeared to contradict his frail anatomy, suggesting that his power derived from mental or metaphysical sources rather than physical conditioning. Toloo claimed to embody Jimmy Binn’s own mind and heart, asserting that belief and desire could reshape reality and personal capability. According to his explanation, he existed as a projection of Jimmy’s unrealized potential, appearing only to guide him toward self-confidence and transformation. Following a final conversation in a nearby park, Toloo vanished without explanation, leaving only ambiguous physical evidence of his presence.

tooth.name: Tooth
tooth.origin: Tooth was one of the Dwarves of Nidavellir who helped Tony Stark build the weapons that would be used to oppose the Serpent's Worthy, although he did so with hostility towards Tony. When Tony stumbled on some metal ingots due to drunkenness, Tooth was furious and punched him but Tony reacted by returning the blow, so they made up and toasted all together. In truth, however, Tooth was a traitor working under a Smoke Elf duo that were in league with The Serpent. He'd procured some of Stark's hair so they could fashion an assassin out of it through their magic, all in exchange for joining the winning team. But was lethally silenced by his co-conspirators to ensure the secret remains buried.

toothgnasher.name: Toothgnasher
toothgnasher.origin: Toothgnasher and Toothgrinder are the mystical goats of Thor that pull his chariot. Thor left Toothgnasher in charge of guarding a Mjolnir from another dimension, after it caused his best friend Volstagg to become a murderous maniac. After Volstagg regained the hammer, Toothgnasher ambushed him in the old City of Asgard in the Asgard-realm in order to make Volstagg relinquish the hammer. However, Toothgnasher was unexpectedly grabbed by the monster Mangog and brutally decapitated. Following the War of the Realms, Loki used magic to resurrect Toothgnasher as a gift to Thor, who had been given the crown of Asgard by Odin.

toothgrinder.name: Toothgrinder
toothgrinder.origin: Toothgnasher and Toothgrinder are the mystical goats of Thor that pull his chariot. After Thor had become unworthy to lift Mjolnir, Jane Foster became the one to take on the mantle of Thor. While drinking with Jane at Odin's Fav Tavern, The Warriors Three and Jane all got into a fight with drunken Asgardians and were thrown out. After, under the guise of having her prove herself (but really just wanting to have fun), The Warriors Three had Jane perform many feats that Thor Odinson had accomplished. One of those feats was to ride Toothgnasher. After completing a number of feats, the Warriors Three and Jane celebrated and they accepted her as a new Thor.

top man.name: Top Man
top man.origin: The Top Man was a Maggia leader who bought the Baxter Building to steal the scientific equipment of Mister Fantastic of the Fantastic Four. After purchasing the property, the Top Man posed as the lobby attendant to get a lay of the land. He later delivered an eviction notice to the Fantastic Four in this guise, but the team refused to leave. Arming his men with suits that protected them from harm, he sent them to claim the Baxter Building by force. This led to a clash with the Fantastic Four, who eventually subdued the invaders. When his minion Gimlet almost revealed his identity, the Top Man shot him dead. His claims of coming to the aid of the FF were seen through by Reed Richards who unmasked the Top Man and turned him over to the authorities. Sources state that the courts found the transaction to be invalid and ownership of the Baxter Building was transferred back to Walter Collins. For his failure, the Top Man was killed in jail by a Maggia assassin.

topaz.name: Topaz
topaz.origin: Topaz's origins and real name are unknown, even to herself. As an infant, Topaz was found and adopted by the sorcerer Taboo, who was living in an Indian prison camp at the time. Taboo saw potential in the abandoned young girl who had only known lonliness, and persuaded her to attack the prison's soldiers and break them both out. From then, he became her father figure while she became the familiar through whom he performed his magic. Years later, Taboo forced Topaz to control the werewolf known as Jack Russell for a time. (Russell was searching for the magical Darkhold tome). Cast out by Taboo after refusing to kill Russell, Topaz chose to help Jack learn to control his werewolf powers, and also became his lover. She assisted Russell many times, including helping him to learn about his family history and even helping him take on Dracula. Jack's grandmother, Maria Russoff, once used Topaz's power to raise an army of zombies as part of a mad revenge scheme. Topaz eventually restored her to sanity, and Maria sacrificed her life once she saw that her actions had placed her grandson in danger. At one point, Topaz was exploited by Dr. Glitternight, who stole a portion of her soul to create a Soul-Beast. Topaz later used her powers to save Jack's sister, Lissa, from the werewolf curse (which was passed from generation to generation within their family). After discovering what Glitternight had done to her, Topaz fought and defeated the villain, regaining her soul in the process. She would eventually encounter Mephisto, who lured her and Dracula into his dimension. The demon lord sought to destroy Topaz especially since when she matured, the power of empathy and love she commanded would threaten the evil which Satans like himself wished to perpetuate. Topaz awakened much of her true power early, then temporarily destroyed the lord of Hell. Unfortunately, the demon lord's minions managed to trap her in another dimension with a spell that would remove another portion of her soul and rob her of her empathic powers if she ever left that realm. Later, Mephisto was revealed to be alive, and after he was once again destroyed by Franklin Richards of the Fantastic Four, Topaz was freed from her imprisonment. (Her soul was eventually restored by Doctor Strange and the alien sorcerer known as Urthona). As Topaz reached the age of 21, her powers reached their full potential, and she used them to heal the wounds of Doctor Strange's loyal servant, Wong. She left Strange's side when he briefly turned to black magics, but later returned to aid him in his fight against Dormammu. Later, Topaz led a quiet life for a while, running a bar called The Voodoo Lounge. However, once Dormammu got word of her whereabouts, he sought revenge and had one of his agents enslave the young sorceress. Once again, Doctor Strange came to her rescue. Topaz later helped Doctor Strange in yet another battle, joining forces with Jennifer Kale and Satana against the Hellphyr force and fighting yet more zombies and demons. After winning this battle, Topaz decided to leave Strange's side yet again, founding the group known as the Witches in order to protect the world from mystical threats and prevent would-be thieves from stealing the Kale family's Tome of Zhered-Na.

fields.history: Topaz's origins and real name are unknown, even to herself. As an infant, Topaz was found and adopted by the sorcerer Taboo, who was living in an Indian prison camp at the time. Taboo saw potential in the abandoned young girl who had only known lonliness, and persuaded her to attack the prison's soldiers and break them both out. From then, he became her father figure while she became the familiar through whom he performed his magic. Years later, Taboo forced Topaz to control the werewolf known as Jack Russell for a time. (Russell was searching for the magical Darkhold tome). Cast out by Taboo after refusing to kill Russell, Topaz chose to help Jack learn to control his werewolf powers, and also became his lover. She assisted Russell many times, including helping him to learn about his family history and even helping him take on Dracula. Jack's grandmother, Maria Russoff, once used Topaz's power to raise an army of zombies as part of a mad revenge scheme. Topaz eventually restored her to sanity, and Maria sacrificed her life once she saw that her actions had placed her grandson in danger. At one point, Topaz was exploited by Dr. Glitternight, who stole a portion of her soul to create a Soul-Beast. Topaz later used her powers to save Jack's sister, Lissa, from the werewolf curse (which was passed from generation to generation within their family). After discovering what Glitternight had done to her, Topaz fought and defeated the villain, regaining her soul in the process. She would eventually encounter Mephisto, who lured her and Dracula into his dimension. The demon lord sought to destroy Topaz especially since when she matured, the power of empathy and love she commanded would threaten the evil which Satans like himself wished to perpetuate. Topaz awakened much of her true power early, then temporarily destroyed the lord of Hell. Unfortunately, the demon lord's minions managed to trap her in another dimension with a spell that would remove another portion of her soul and rob her of her empathic powers if she ever left that realm. Later, Mephisto was revealed to be alive, and after he was once again destroyed by Franklin Richards of the Fantastic Four, Topaz was freed from her imprisonment. (Her soul was eventually restored by Doctor Strange and the alien sorcerer known as Urthona). As Topaz reached the age of 21, her powers reached their full potential, and she used them to heal the wounds of Doctor Strange's loyal servant, Wong. She left Strange's side when he briefly turned to black magics, but later returned to aid him in his fight against Dormammu. Later, Topaz led a quiet life for a while, running a bar called The Voodoo Lounge. However, once Dormammu got word of her whereabouts, he sought revenge and had one of his agents enslave the young sorceress. Once again, Doctor Strange came to her rescue. Topaz later helped Doctor Strange in yet another battle, joining forces with Jennifer Kale and Satana against the Hellphyr force and fighting yet more zombies and demons. After winning this battle, Topaz decided to leave Strange's side yet again, founding the group known as the Witches in order to protect the world from mystical threats and prevent would-be thieves from stealing the Kale family's Tome of Zhered-Na.

topher.name: Topher
topher.origin: ===Origin=== Topher, born around 1900, was turned into a vampire at age sixteen. Following the Great Depression, he amassed wealth by playing the stock market and continued to live luxuriously for decades. By the 1940s, he had already sired at least one other vampire, and in 1979, he drank the blood of a mutant. He lived in comfort for years as a wealthy recluse. ===Runaways=== Around 2001, Topher lost his fortune in the aftermath of the dot-com crash and turned to crime. He was accompanied by two vampire minions, one of whom he had likely turned in the 1940s. During a robbery at a convenience store in Los Feliz, California, Topher encountered the Runaways. When his minions fled, he pretended they were his parents and claimed he had been forced into crime. Team leader Alex Wilder suspected deception but played along, anticipating that Topher would betray them. He saw the opportunity to use Topher’s actions as a training experience for the team. While pretending to be a new member, Topher sowed discord among the Runaways by showing romantic interest in both Nico Minoru and Karolina Dean. As Wilder expected, Topher eventually attacked and attempted to feed on the team. However, feeding on Karolina proved fatal. Her blood, charged with solar energy, was toxic to him, and the encounter killed him. His two surviving minions were later destroyed by sunlight through actions taken by the Pride.

topographical man.name: Topographical Man
topographical man.origin: The Topographical Man is an ancient, enigmatic being whose origins remain unknown. In the 31st century, Nikki, a Mercurian survivor of the Badoon genocide, escaped in her family spaceship. Stranded near the edge of the Solar System, she discovered a derelict ship with a mysteriously deceased crew. She survived aboard it, using it to explore lifeless planets that once supported life. Nikki eventually joined the Guardians of the Galaxy. Together, they uncovered the cause of the planetary death—an entity known as Karanada—and were swallowed by it. Inside, they found themselves on the surface of the Topographical Man, though they initially believed it to be another planet. Vance Astro flew their ship through the being’s surface and confirmed from space that it was a massive humanoid entity. Guided by Starhawk to the Convent of the Living Fire, Nikki underwent the ritual of flame and merged with the Godhead, gaining an immense astral form. Vance Astro, whose essence had also merged with the Topographical Man during the battle with Karanada, joined with Nikki. Their combined will grew to match the scale of the Topographical Man. They embraced him, forcing him to commit an 'act of love'—a concept fundamentally opposed to his nature as the antithesis of life—thereby destroying him.
